In our luxury villa with underfloor heating, you will need a fireplace not because you are cold, but just for pleasure. You can make a fire, barbecue and roast marshmallows in our fire pit. Have a good time with your whole family and children in this chic and peaceful place. Feel yourself breathing.

reviews.text: Ev resimlerden daha küçüktü, oturma alanı konforsuzdu.otopark alanı var diye yazıyor ancak otoparka girdik diye akıllı ev sistemi bozulmuş, havuz soğudu ve bir daha ısınmadı. böyle bir akıllı sistemle problem var mı diye uzaktan sürekli kontrol edilmesi gerekir.Ev sahibimizden bu konuda destek alamadığımız gibi otoparka girerek sistemi bozdunuz gibi bir eleştiri aldık,akıllı ev sisteminin uzaktan da resetlenip bi şekilde o havuzun ısıtılacak hale gelmesini beklerdik.Evi bu mevsimde özellikle sıcak havuzu var diye kiraladık ancak bütün haftasonunu evin içinde geçirmek zorunda kaldık.Bu aksilik sonrasında ev sahibi bize 12 yerine geç bi saatte evden çıkış yapabileceğimizi söyledi ancak 2 saat sonra buna cevap vermediğimizi, evin kiralandığını ve 12 de çıkış yapmamız gerektiğini söyledi .salon çok konforsuzdu, evde kupa bardak ve yedek tuvalet kağıdı yoktu. Havuzun ısınmasıyla ilgili sorunumuzun olduğunu bilmelerine rağmen aramalarımıza çok geç dönüldü. internet çalışmıyordu.

Gerçekten kendimizi evimizde hissettik. Fotoğraflarda ne gösteriliyorsa her şey vardı. Özellikle evin beyaz eşyasının eksiksiz oluşu işimizi çok kolaylaştırdı. En önemlisi de temizlik konusunda bir sıkıntı yaşamamızdı. Sorularımıza hemen yanıt verildi. Aynı bölgeye gitmemiz halinde yine burada konaklarız. Herkes gönül rahatlığıyla bu evi tercih edebilir.

Isıtmalı havuz gerçekten çok keyifliydi, bir çok kişinin konaklayabileceği odalar mevcuttu, tüm detaylar özenle düşünülmüştü, ev sahibi Miraç Hanım giriş ve çıkış konusunda çok yardımcı oldu, konum Ağva Merkeze çok yakındı bu yüzden rahatlıkla merkeze ulaşım sağlayabildik, bu villada konaklama deneyimi için tekrardan ev sahiplerine teşekkür ederim, inanılmaz keyifliydi

description: Welcome to our 2 Bedrooms 1st Floor Apartment in Sultanahmet - Istanbul, a charming modern house recently renovated in 2013 and designed for our guests into apartments with modern facilities, nestled in the heart of the old city.

reviews.text: Very good host, responsive and helpful, Location was great with less than 10mins walk to the blue mosque, Hagia sophia, apartment was as described and as per the photos. Only downside was slow and intermittent internet connection. There was a power breakdown in the area for about 8 hours which was obviously beyond host's control but there was no generator or any alternate arrangements which made that day very difficult. Overall, I am satisfied with the price, location, size and facilities in the apartment.

This apartment needs total renovation. What you see on photos is not what you will actually see inside.
Walls, floor, doors, carpets are dirty, fungus is everywhere.
Host provided us really dirty towels and linens, no shampoo or shower gel.
It's really located in 5 min walking distance to Blue Mosque, but through bars on the windows you will see ruined scaring building with no doors and windows.

Not worth the money, condo is very very dirty and huge smell of mold. We had to leave the first day to book a last minute Airbnb. Good location that’s it! Windows not closing properly. My family after one night had trouble breathing and started coughing. Ac not working properly. Beds and blankets have black marks. Hair on the bed. Absolute disaster. Bad experience and host needs to change is home condition.

AVOID. The property is not safe or fit for use. This apartment ruined my planned scheduled stay in Istanbul. When I moved in to the apartment, I was told by the host that there was a gas leak and it was being fixed. I left it at that. Then there was construction work being done to the neighbouring property where the noise and vibration was felt in the apartment. Despite the host telling me the construction will stop at 5.30 pm on the day I moved in and will no longer happen, the construction work occurred during my whole 4 days stay where there was constant drilling vibration and noise from 9 am to 5.30 pm every day (except Friday). It does not look like major construction works which could go on for weeks. The hot and cold water did not work for 3 days. On one day, the plumber was at the property fixing the boiler at 4 am in the morning, with the boiler situated right outside the apartment the pipes were banging all night/morning. When I was told the hot and cold water was finally fixed with a replacement boiler, the hot water was a dark brown murky colour and continued to be even after letting the water run for a while. Above the ground floor apartment is another apartment upstairs. The guests in the upstairs apartment were partying every night til early hours in the morning around 4 to 5 am. This ruined my stay, as I had planned with the kids to wake up early and then leave to visit sites, but they were not able to get a proper nights sleep, I could not stay to the scheduled plans I had made to see all the sites. The host was responsive and paid for my taxi back to the airport, which is why I gave it a one star. If you are still minded to book this apartment based on the other reviews, make sure you ask the host about the gas leak, construction next door, hot water, heating and whether parties are allowed in the building. Although the property was refurbished in 2013 (I think from the description), it does need a make over again, as the bathroom could do with updates, especially the door, as that does not shut or lock property and so you need to tell people you are going to use the bathroom. I have reported this to Airbnb with videos and photos.

The washroom is not beat up but just one level above. The toilet does not always flush properly and will require multiple flushes. The toilet seat is loose. The shower area leaves a lot to be desired. Safety does not seem to be a concern as a door stop is mounted on the floor smack in the middle of the space, which is a constant tripping hazard as you try to reach the towel bar.
The second day after arrival, the cleaning lady would take our dirty towels off the floor and put them back up on the towel bar. Which is beyond disgusting. When I brought it to his attention and he immediately replaced our towels.
The fridge in the kitchen is iced over and has a smell. We only had bottles of water in it. The hot plate provided in the apartment sits on an open space above the drawers that contain the utensils, any spill over from cooking will go right into the drawer. Literally it is sitting on top of a rectangular hole in the granite counter top. On day three of our stay (we stayed for 5 nights) we walk into the apartment and the hot plate is missing and the nice big hole in the counter top is exposed. He must have needed it the hot plate at another place so he took it there and as he noticed that we are not using it. I find that appalling as he did not ask and he just took it out. I rented a space with hot plate and I expect to stay there for my whole stay or at least ask if I have any plans of using it.
The curtains are not darkening curtains and the apt will be lit up come sunrise.
The advertisement will lead you to believe that you are getting a special place, but it is far from special. The apartment building is beat up and an old building. The entrance to the building is small and tight and always cluttered and used as a storage space. People on the second floor would store their stroller on at the crowded first floor and would completely block the entrance to the apartment and the building. He would also use the space to drop off linen sheets and towels. So it is always crowded and unsafe.
The Host was there on time and let us in with no issues and gave some brief instructions and could fairly easily communicate via WhatsApp.
Before booking, his communication was good. After booking he was brief on instructions and slow on communication. After arriving he was good at communication via WhatsApp.
He is a very nice person and will try and do things when you ask him. During the last night, he arranged for a van to take us to the airport at 3:00 am. The van did not show up. I called him at 3:00 am and he got us a replacement van within 30 minutes that saved our flight. And I appreciate that.
For the money that he's asking There are many that are far better.
I stayed there with my family, two adults and three kids.
You do not get to know the exact location of the apartment until after you book. The proximity of the building to major attractions is great. But the location itself, neighbourhood, is less than desirable. It is a run down neighbourhood with a deserted building across the street which makes it all the more earie.

description: My flat is two bedroom and one saloon .Transportation is very easy everywhere..

reviews.text: I was really lucky to find this place and luckier to meet this host. The apartment was completely clean and comfortable, everything that I needed was ready and well organized. Hasan was a perfect, supportive and kind person. He knew many cultures and English well. Public transportation is also very good and with KM23 bus you can get to metro easily. Thanks a lot Hasan

I stayed with Hasan for a night because I had an early flight the next day. He was such a gracious and nice host - the place was clean, so close to SAW airport, and the bed was comfortable. Hasan was also quick to respond, and was nice enough to wake up at 6 am and call me a cab!! Totally recommended for anyone looking to stay in that neighbourhood of İstanbul!

Amazing hospitality, Hasan has been such a great host, helpful in many ways (for helping with transport, and post office, and turkish translation), friendly, curious about the world, with interest in people. The room and the house are very nice, warm, comfortable, clean.

Hasan made our very short stay (one night) memorable by going above and beyond the call of duty: introducing us to his barber (my husband badly needed a cut) and to a great local cafe. His flat is cosy and warm on a cool evening, with a great selection of tea and a comfortable bed. Hasan is a generous host and an excellent Turkish-language tutor!

His apartment is perfect for anyone wanting to experience a real Turkish neighbourhood. In the Asian side of Istanbul, Pendik is a characterful suburb of the old city, with links to the centre (the Metro now extends out to Pendik and will soon be heading to the airport). It is about 10 minutes from the airport by cab, but make sure you call Hasan so that he can give the driver directions -- we got lost on our way to his apartment, and then caught up in road works, but that was completely our fault because we did not! Our return journey, on the other hand, was quick and trouble free.
Hasan is very kind and nice, and helpful person. he helped with taxi. His house very comfortable and clean and very nice. I recommend sin duda))

description:
Located in the heart of Istanbul’s prestigious Bebek district, which has become a famous landmark with internationally recognised restaurants, stunning bosphorus line with exceptional sunsets.

This stylish apartment features 2 bedrooms, a living room with a sofa and fold-out bed, a full kitchen, bathroom, separate toilet, balcony, and A/C in all rooms. Accommodates up to 6 guests. Steps away from top restaurants, cafes, and boutiques. Luxury yacht tours available nearby.

reviews.text: The apartment is clean, tidy, and comfortable. Its location is excellent, and most importantly, the landlord was very helpful. For those arriving by car, there is no on-street parking, but there are nearby (paid) parking spaces you can use. There is no elevator, so those with an elderly or disabled relative might find it difficult to get in and out. Overall, I recommend it and will definitely return if I have the chance.

Our stay at the Airbnb in Bebek, Istanbul was simply fantastic. The apartment was spotlessly clean and its location was superb, offering scenic Bosphorus view which was 2 mins away and easy access to all the great restaurants. The warm interiors and AC room ensured a comfortable stay, and having a first-floor unit was very convenient. Hosts Atish and Condo were incredibly kind and helpful, even granting us a late check-out. Highly recommend for an unforgettable Istanbul experience!
We had a great stay! The host was very responsive and pleasant to interact with throughout. The apartment was clean and exactly as described. The location was perfect for us. We’d happily book again!

Ali and Ahmet were great hosts and very responsive throughout our trip. The apartment was immaculate and spacious -- big enough for my family of four. We felt right at home and were able to use the kitchen to make breakfast every morning. Bebek gets 5/5 in terms of a place to stay as there is tons to do and see, plus it has great restaurants and a nearby ferry boat station. The downside to our stay was that the street and nearby Lucca were a bit noisy, but overall, we slept comfortably.

Great place to stay in Bebek. Place is as shown in pictures. Ali is great responsive host. Great location near Main Street (little noisy at night) with music from restaurant/bars nearby but it is the price you pay to stay in the middle of Bebek:) worth it!

description: "Step into a serene, modern haven nestled in the pulse of the city. reviews.text:
Fantastic place to stay near Taksim! Incredibly pleasant ground-floor studio 2 blocks from main shopping street and bus stop. GREAT shower and clean, modern, compact place to stay. Mini-fridge and 2-burner stove top with all the kitchen storage space you could ever need. Large comfy bed. And convenient washer right in the space. I stayed just under 2 weeks and can hardly wait to return and stay again.
Erfan was immediately availalbe for all communications. He worked with me on all check-in and check-out needs. A very gracious host.
EXCELLENT value - can't beat the price for a beautiul space in the middle of everything.
VERY HIGHLY recommend!!

Nice cost studio in the area of Taksim. Near to restaurants and places of interest 20mins walking. Mostly a quite neighborhood. Was very communicative host. The check in process is easy. The place is clean, doesn’t have to many kitchen supplies though. Recommend for a person or couple who has no interest in cooking. Small fridge to keep beverages cold. Working a/C. Bed big enough for two. The only but were the sheets and pillows, need to improve. 40mins to galata tower
Allowed me to check in a bit early, host was responsive, good price for the area, AC was phenomenal, bathroom was extremely clean with great water pressure, bed was clean

This apartment is great in location - 10 minute walking distance to Taksim and Nişantaşı. It has been nicely renovated. Even though it is a bit small, it is sufficient for 2 people.
The kitchen and bathroom are new and clean.
The host has been very friendly and responsive. He answered all questions we had, the check-in & check-out procedures were quite easy.

The apartment is safe and clean. There are many cafes and restaurants nearby, and Taksim Square is a short walk away. The host is very friendly and responsive. I would book the place again if I visit.

description: This stylish place is close to must-see destinations.

reviews.text:

The host is very friendly and accommodating and gave us great recommendations for what to visit and how to get there.

reviews.text:
Stay at Hakan's place was good overall, with some improvements to note.
Positives:
- Location is unbeatable, potentially the best in IST. The street is quiet yet charming, with beautiful cafes, great restaurants, 2 mins from Istiklal street, and very walkable.
- Host was very responsive, promptly addressing our needs.
- Apartment is very nice, with almost all amenities (exactly as per pictures).
Things to note:
- We experienced two water outages lasting about a day each (no water in the flat), which was inconvenient and not mentioned beforehand. While this is a Beyoglu issue, a heads-up when booking would have been appreciated.
- The building is very old and poorly maintained: the door has no lock and must be forced open every time. Though the apartment is on the first floor, the stairs are not well maintained—wooden, with some broken pieces.

Tüm gece uçak yolculuğumdan sonra, önceki müşterinin çıkışından sonra bir an önce temizlik yapılıp erken check in talep ettim Saatlerce, yardımcı olmasını bekledim ama 1 dk bile erken giriş yaptırmadı. Aynı şekilde kısa süre geç çıkış istedim, Saatinde çıkış istedi ve yardımcı olmadı.
Konum temizlik ve fiyat olarak gayet uygundu
Konum olarak çok, yakının otopark olması, Taksim'e de Cihangire de yakın olması çok işime yaradı. Ev de gayet güzeldi.

description: Rare duplex 1BR apartment in Taksim360, with a balcony overlooking a quiet, charming street inside the project. This split-level home features a queen bed and sofa bed, elegant lighting, full kitchen, Smart TV, Wi-Fi, safe, and laundry set. Ideal for couples or friends looking for a unique stay near Istiklal Street and all transport links. Baby crib/high chair available on request.

reviews.text: Definitely the best place of accommodation we have been to in Istanbul! It was as described, clean, cosy and very convenient for our family. The location is outstanding as is the building complex itself. The availability of a parking lot was absolutely a game changer for us since the places with parking on site in Istanbul are very few. The hosts were always available, helpful and friendly which was greatly appreciated. We will definitely come back!

Overall, I had a great stay. There was a small issue at check-in, but it was resolved quickly. The host was very attentive, stayed in touch throughout my stay, checked in regularly to make sure everything was okay, and responded to all my questions very quickly. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and well prepared. The complimentary treats were a thoughtful touch. The location is excellent, within walking distance of Taksim Square, and having parking available was a big advantage. I would happily stay here again and highly recommend it.

The apartment was exactly as pictured—clean, comfortable, and well maintained. The location was excellent, with plenty of shops, cafés, and restaurants just a short walk away, making it easy to explore the area. The host was very responsive and communicated clearly throughout our stay. They also arranged our airport transfer, which made our arrival and departure very convenient. Overall, we had a great experience and would happily stay here again.

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb
The apartment was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and beautifully decorated.
The location was perfect, close to major attractions, restaurants, and public transportation. The host was incredibly hospitable, always responsive.
Everything was well-organized, and I truly felt at home. I would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul and would definitely stay here.

Erhan is a great host and Ms Berrak was more than helpful and proactive. The appartment is greatly located close to all places of interest.
It's new, clean and cozy. The kitchen has everything you need to cook and have your meal. The bed is comfortable and pillow choice provides for a good sleep. I would really like to come back. Thank you!

description: wonderful central location terrace apartment unique view fascinating

reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! It’s a lovely place, very well located, and exactly as described. The space was clean, comfortable, and the amenities were as described. The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, making my stay even more enjoyable. Highly recommend!

Good place for staying a couple of nights. We were here 2 time. 1 time was great, in a cold time, very quite. But unforturatelly at warm days it started to be noisy because of working ac on the balcony and around you, so if you sensitive to it, be careful, but it's a common problem for a lot of places in Istanbul not the hotel problem. Other things are good. I like that you have washing machine, small kitchen, fridge. Also balcony and the view is really cute, you can see the city for a bit. The bed is good, lights around the bed is good, also you can watch the smart tv. The room is quite cozy and nice, but i think it could be great to do a small renovation. The shower is good too. But sometimes it smells cigarette in a bathroom. The location is good: Macka Park is 5 minutes, Nisantasi is also 10 minutes, Osmanbey metro 7-10 min, cafe restaurants 7-15 min. Some shops for drinks and food 5-10 min.

Everything was good and we had a pleasant stay. The hotel was clean and comfortable, and the staff were friendly and helpful. The location is very convenient with easy access to different parts of the city. Overall, it was a good experience and I would recommend this hotel.

Great stay, everything was comfortable and clean!
Also we loved the location! Many great cafes, parks and beautiful neighbourhood around!
Fotoğraflarda görüldüğü gibiydi,gayet temizdi ve Osmanbey merkezde hemen aşağıki sokakta metroya çok yakın.ayrıca Harbiye açık hava tiyatrosuna da çok yakın.

description: It's impossible to be bored at this small and cute apartment. You can play a little game with your child as I aim after hosting him.

reviews.text:
Pros:
Great location, in a walkable neighborhood with lots to do and close to very good restaurants and beautiful seaside parks.
Cons:
The place, however, is very crammed, there was no place to put the clothes. The bathroom was tiny, and the shower had a lot mold in the caulking. The bathroom also has a bad smell, so had to keep the door closed at all times. The bathroom sink is as small as an airplane sink, and it is impossible to even splash water on your face or brush your teeth on it. Had to use the kitchen sink instead. The wifi is extremely slow and couldn’t even open google maps easily, which is quite important to use as a tourist. The host mentioned that it because we are using the wifi of a neighboring apartment lol
Overall it is an OK deal for the price

Thank you for hosting us, and thank you Ahmet for the prompt response and support.
The apartment was lovely and cozy, heating works well for both the room and the water system, however we’d loved it if the bathroom was out of the damp smell.
The washing machine was a life saver for us, as we brought minimum amount of clothes to wear on our trip. It would be great to add instructions in English on the washing machine.
It was easy to locate on the map, and easier to go back to the metro and bus station, the shops and restaurants were the greatest so it’s worth spending a full chill day around the Airbnb.

The location was so nice. You could reach everything you need by walk. The house was not so clean, there were bugs around and the bed sheets were not nice. If you plan to cook at home, the kitchen stuff is not enough or too old. The building has a continuous gas smell. It could be a bit cheaper considering all these issues.

Perfect area for my stay. In the heart of kadıköy with bars, restaurants and cafes everywhere. There's also a super market nearby which made it very convenient for me. Very close to metro, ferry and bus station too for local bus and airport shuttle.
Super duper friendly hosts, very responsive and helpful. I felt right at home in this apartment. It's small but it had everything I need for a comfortable stay. There's no lift to get up so be prepared to carry your luggages!
Overall, I would recommend this apartment. Perfect for 2 people, or a solo traveler.

Had a wonderful stay at this airbnb. It has everything you need — washing machine, kitchen (with cooking appliances), bed, hot shower, heater. A nice small cozy studio apartment. Stayed here for 10 days during my travel to istanbul. The location is in a lively street in Kadikoy. Getting here from the airport is also easy. Host is very responsive, kind, and helpful throughout the stay.

description: Our suite, located on floors -1 and -2 of our building, offers a comfortable accommodation experience with its elegant design. The room has a TV with Netflix access, a kitchen and an elegant separation between the bed and the living area. The swivel television can be viewed comfortably from any angle. Our building is centrally located, close to the subway station and within walking distance to transportation. There is a small window in the room for ventilation.

reviews.text: Çok şık ve rahat bir iç tasarımı var. Mutfak banyo ve yatak odası temiz ve düzenliydi ihtiyacınız olan herhangi bir durumda iletişime geçip anında yanıt alabiliyorsunuz. Odaya girince size su, çay, şeker gibi temel gıdaları hazır olarak veriyorlar. Odada balkon yok ve cam açılmamasına rağmen içerideki havalandırma ve klima bu eksiği rahatlıkla kapatıyor. Şüphesiz, güzel düşünülmüş bir mimari ve şık tasarımıyla güzel bir oda. Rahat bir tatil geçirdik, ayrıca desteğe ihtiyacınız olduğunda resepsiyona ilettiğinizde sizinle hızlıca ilgileniyorlar.

İstanbul Beşiktaş’taki Nish Suits’te geçirdiğim konaklama gerçekten beklentilerimin çok üzerinde bir deneyimdi. Otele adım attığım andan itibaren kendimi son derece güvende, rahat ve özel hissettim. Özellikle İlkim Bey ve Ahmet Bey’in ilgi ve alakası sayesinde odama yerleştiğim ilk dakikadan çıkış yaptığıma kadar her şey kusursuz ilerledi.
Odalar son derece temiz, ferah ve modern bir şekilde dizayn edilmiş. Hem iş hem de tatil amaçlı seyahat edenler için mükemmel bir konfor sunuyor. Sessiz bir ortam, rahat bir yatak, sıcak bir karşılama ve ihtiyaç duyabileceğiniz tüm detayların düşünülmüş olması burayı diğerlerinden ayırıyor.
Konum olarak Beşiktaş’ın kalbinde olması büyük bir avantaj. Ulaşım çok kolay, çevrede restoranlar, kafeler ve gezilecek pek çok yer bulunuyor. Buna rağmen otel sakin ve huzurlu bir atmosfere sahip.
Ama tüm bu güzelliklerin ötesinde konaklamamı özel kılan şey gerçekten personelin misafirperverliği oldu. İlkim Bey ve Ahmet Bey’in güler yüzü, çözüm odaklı yaklaşım
Çok memnun kaldım, gerçekten tertemizdi gönül rahatlığıyla konaklayabilirsiniz.
Herşey fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi konumu güzel
Check-in çok hızlı ve sorunsuz geçti. Odalar resimlerdeki gibi çok temizdi. Teşekkürler herşey için 🙏🏼

description: In the heart of the district, please be ready to explore Kadıköy very easily with attractions nearby our hotel and enjoy about your sightseeing. Hotel is located 1 minute to ferry, 2 minutes to bazaar and 5 minutes away from the bull statue, which is considered the center of Kadıköy.

reviews.text:
Sorunlar:
1) En büyük sorun odanın fotoğrafta gözüktüğünden kat kat küçük olması. Hareket etmek çok rahat değildi ve içindeki yatak odanın çoğunu kaplıyordu.
2) Yan odaların sesleri bizim odamıza geliyordu o yüzden mahremiyet konusunda biraz sıkıntı vardı.
3) Banyosu, özellikle duş çok küçüktü, rahat hareket edilmiyordu ve duş başlığının asılı olduğu aparat bozuk olduğu için zor duş alınıyordu. Ayrıca kabin de sıkıntılıydı su kabinin dışarısına çıkıyordu. Tehlikeli
4) Balkon da aynı şekilde çok küçüktü. Sadece 1 kişi kullanabiliyordu.

İyi yönleri:
1) En iyi yönü gerçekten temiz olması ve bunun hissedilebilmesiydi. Normalde yatak temizliği konusunda çok titizimdir ve kolay kolay rahat edemem ama gerçekten yastıklar da çarşaflar da temizdi ve temiz kokuyorlardı. Havlular da aynı şekilde temizdi.
2) Oda her ne kadar küçük olsa da dekorasyon açısından iyiydi ve içinde bulunmak keyifli hissettirdi.
3) Konumu gerçekten çok merkezi bir yer. İstediğiniz her yere kolaylıkla ulaşabilirsiniz.

Oda genel olarak fotoğraftaki gibiydi ama çok küçüktü biraz daha büyük olsaydı süper olurdu. Onun haricinde temizdi ve konum olarak çok iyiydi sadece konumdan kaynaklı gece fazla gürültü oluyor ama o da normal çünkü Kadıköy’ün göbeğinde konaklıyorsunuz. Kısa süreli konaklama için fiyat performans diyebilirim.

İlk kiralama deneyimimde tercih edebileceğim en iyi yer olabilir. Aşırı temiz olduğuna dair yorumlardan dolayı tutmuştum ve cidden aşırı temizdi. Her yere olan ulaşım çok kolay olduğu için konumu benim için çok kullanışlıydı. Çok ilgililerdi ve hep iletişimdeydiler. Kesinlikle tercih edebileceğiniz bir yer.
İnanılmaz temizdi, yatak yastiklar her şey çok rahattı, çalışanlar çok tatlıydı. Kesinlikle tekrar geldiğimde sizi tercih edeceğim
Konumu oldukça iyi, temiz ve göründüğü gibiydi. Biz çok memnun kaldık

description:
Our flat is pretty quiet and peaceful, although it is in the heart of Galata. The flat is just a few steps away from Galata Tower and Karaköy.

The flat designed to provide all your needs. If you want, you can work from home with high-speed internet or cook for dinner or read a book peacefully in silence with high consantration.

Out of the building, there are a lot of boutique cafes to eat something and a lot of local market for shooping

reviews.text:
Great location near Galata, very convenient for exploring Istanbul. The hosts were responsive and helpful, and arranged an airport taxi, which we appreciated.
That said, the apartment is on the -1 floor, so it feels enclosed with limited ventilation. There was a noticeable smell indoors and outdoors, especially around the balcony. We chose this Airbnb hoping to have dinner there, but never used it because of the smell. We also could not open the windows much because the outside smell was bad. As someone with a lung condition, I found it hard to breathe at times. The AC made the stay manageable; without it, I likely would have considered leaving.
The bathroom did not fully match the photos. It was close to the bed, with a glass door that had gaps, so odors reached the sleeping area. The window facing the bed also made privacy feel limited. Cleanliness and maintenance could improve: worn furniture, basic comfort, limited pillows, and towels dried slowly from humidity and poor airflow.

Checking. We were very disappointed with our stay. I’m not going to lie, even though the host did communicate with us, the property was very messy and not clean to the standard we expected.
There were stains on the walls, lack of privacy, and safety concerns. For the price we paid, we expected a much better standard and a more comfortable experience. I hope the host takes this feedback seriously, works on the property, and pays much closer attention to the details and cleanliness.

I had a wonderful stay at an Airbnb recently. The host was incredibly friendly and responsive, making check-in a breeze. The apartment was clean, well-maintained, and beautifully decorated. I loved the cozy atmosphere and the little touches that made it feel like home. The location was perfect, with easy access to local attractions and restaurants. Overall, I highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a comfortable and enjoyable stay!

Well placed apartment, just 5 minutes walk from Galata Tower, plenty of shops/super-markets close by, although there is a Metro station and trams 5 minutes away, we walked everywhere, good exercise. Easy walk to the other side of the Bosphorus, about 30-40 minutes. Down hill on the way there, but as you might guess, uphill on the way back, but that's fine, coz you'll be near home. I'd advise taking the offered transfer from the airports. We caught a taxi from the airport to the apartment, A) it was more expensive, and B) he dropped us off in thew wrong street, thank god for Google maps. Owners are always responsive to queries and happy to advise. The neighbourhood is usually quite, the only night it got a little noisy was the Friday, there was a Band/Disco going on until 11.00 ish, but after that it was back to normal. Well worth the money.

The apartment is well located, clean and comfortable, I would definitely come back if I have the opportunity, you will have all the amenities, near shops restaurants and landmarks. Totally recommended:)

description: Nearby Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque and Grand Bazar

reviews.text:
I really loved the place. It matches the description and photos listed on airbnb.
The owner is very friendly and responsive.
The location is superb, very close to the main sights. There are plenty of restaurants nearby and the best çiğköfte spot in Istanbul is just around the corner.
The room was clean and perfect for 1 person or a couple. They also lock the main entrance at all times and give guests the key so they can leave and return as they wish, which makes is feel very safe. I would definitely recommend staying there!!

Hakan and his brother were very helpful and friendly. I opted to take a taxi from the airport instead of using a transfer service from the hotel. Big mistake. Uber and Bitaksi cannot pickup from the airport so you have to take an airport taxi or other hotel transfer. Taxi driver added “toll” costs which were bogus as we didn’t take the tunnel. I was using credit card so I couldn’t negotiate. Hakan arranged taxi for me when I was leaving, which was much better. He provided information on tours and I did the Bosphorus cruise. Nice, clean and quiet room. You can walk to sites and restaurants. Highly recommend.

The room was small but comfortable bed, hot water and decent WiFi. Host was friendly and responsive through whats app. We had no problems finding the place and checking in. Within walking distance to bus stop, Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque but still in a more quiet neighborhood. Would stay here again!

Great place to stay in Old city Istanbul. Walking distance to Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque & bazaars! Also a lot of great food options. Hakan was very helpful with checking in and also setting up my airport transfer. Very smooth process and comfortable vehicle. The room had everything I needed as a solo traveler. It was a bit small but the pictures are accurate. Over all great central spot to stay in.
I really enjoyed my stay at Hakem’s place. It was clean, comfortable, and in a good location. The host was helpful and easy to communicate with. I’d definitely recommend it!

description: This special place is close to everything and makes it easy to plan your trip.

reviews.text: Thank you Fevzi for the hospitality. Conveniently located, 5 to 20 minutes walk to almost everything interesting in Taksim. Neighbourhood has active nightlife, shops and restaurants.

Der Vermieter war sehr sehr nett und immer erreichbar. Er konnte uns jederzeit helfen und war der flexibel und freundlich mit den check in/out zeiten. Wir würden bei der nächsten Istanbul reise wieder dieses airbnb buchen.
Everything was perfect
Fevzi fue una persona muy atenta. Siempre respondió a tiempo y mantuvo las condiciones del lugar tal cual en la descripción. Siempre buscan un lugar céntrico lo recomiendo.
很好的房东 很热心

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
Guzel bir konaklama deneyimiydi ancak belli problemler de olduğunu düşünmekteyim.
Öncelikle konum cok guzel eski Haydarpaşa Garinin oraya yakın, yeldegirmeni mahallesinde cafelere falan yakın ve kadikoy de yurume mesafesi.
Ancak ilandaki fotograflarda televizyonun arkasında perde olduğundan cam ve güneş ışığının odaya gireceği varsayiliyor ama verilen oda kapkaranlık ve penceresizdi. Hem ilandaki fotoğraf yanıltıcı hem de bana verilen fiyata göre büyük bir eksiklik gibi hissettirdi. Aynı zamanda şofben çalışmiyoru ve kapının iç tarafinda kapı kolu eksikti. Duvarlar cok ses geçiriyordu ve biz acikcasi ağlayan bir kadının sesini gece boyunca duyduk ve endişelendik umarım istismara uğramiyordur. Acikcasi daha pozitif bir yorum yazmak isterdim ama deneyimimiz böyleydi. En azindan temizdi ve hijyenik bir problemle karşılaşmadık.
Fiyat performans dengesi iyi fakat temizlik odanın ışık ve hava alması konusunda iyiydi diyemem çıkış saatinin erken olduğu kanaatindeyim muhiti güzel rıhtıma markete kafelere vs yakın
Murat bey ile iletişim kurmak kolaydı. Daire fotoğraflardaki gibi temiz ve düzenli. Teşekkür ederim.
ev sahibi çok anlayışlı her konuda yardımcı oldu . evin konumu ve temizliği gayet iyi

Nerdeyse hipotermi geçiriyorduk. Hayatımda kaldığım en soğuk yer. Çatı katı deposunu sözde ev yapmaya çalışmışlar. Kliması kendini ısıtıyor sadece. Sabaha kadar soğuktan uyku uyuyamadık hatta montla uyumaya çalıştım. Ayrıca kapımız kitlenmiyordu, doğal olarak açık kaldı. Ve sabaha kadar gürültü yapan liseli çocuklar da tüy dikti.
Paranla rezil olmak bu olsa gerek Ömrümde yaşadığım en kötü tecrübelerden biriydi. Asla önermiyorum. Bu tarz yerlerin denetlenip air bnb ye açılmaması gerek
We almost suffered hypothermia. It was the coldest place I've ever stayed. They tried to make a makeshift home out of an attic storage room. The air conditioning only heated itself. We couldn't sleep all night because of the cold; I even tried to sleep with my coat on. Also, the door didn't lock, so it was left open. And the noise from the high school kids all night only made things worse. This is what it means to be ripped off for your money. It was one of the worst experiences I've ever had.

description:
Welcome to The Family Haven – a cozy and spacious retreat designed with families in mind. Our apartment offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and warmth, making it ideal for family getaways or extended stays.

Spacious Living Areas
Fully-Equipped Kitchen
Family-Friendly Amenities
Comfortable Bedrooms
Convenient Location

At The Family Haven, we strive to make your stay as comfortable and enjoyable as possible. We look forward to welcoming you and your family!

reviews.text:
Huseyin is a wonderful, friendly, and very responsive host. The apartment is spacious and located in a great part of Istanbul, with convenient access to everything. We had a car and parking was never an issue, which we really appreciated.
That said, there were a few things that impacted the overall comfort of our stay. The AC unit in the living room is quite old and struggled to cool the space. In the bedroom, the ceiling fan wasn’t working, and while Huseyin kindly provided a standing fan after we mentioned it, the fan was old, dusty, and made a constant rattling noise that made it hard to sleep.
The kitchen is described as fully equipped, but we found it missing some essentials - no kettle, no frying pans (had to ask for those) - basics like salt, pepper, or cooking oil would be a great addition as well. These small additions would make a big difference for the described Family Haven.

Everything was as described. Very clear instructions on how to get there, how to enter, how to leave etc. Hosts very responsive, we had everything we needed. Good location, many restaurants, coffees and grocery stores around, 10 minutes to metro and ring road. Good value for money and even better if you're looking for a long-term stay. Recommended!
All is good. That includes the host who was very well communicated. The place was clean, maybe except for the bacon smell lingering the kitchen. Worth the pay.

I was there with my husband. We really liked the apartment. It was very clean and whenever we needed anything they helped us right away. The cleaning was done weekly. There are restaurants, supermarkets, bus stops nearby and Fulya Metro Station is about 12 minutes walking.
Thank you for everything Huseyin and your family!

The apartment is very nice and comfortable!
The host was incredibly attentive, always ready to help with any questions!
I highly recommend this place to anyone – don’t miss your chance to book it while it’s still available!

description:
The apartment is located in the center of Beyoğlu, within walking distance to Karaköy coast, Taksim Square and Galataport, in one of the most tourist-attracting districts in the world.

It is in an area where 24/7 transportation is easily available, you can reach all personal needs within walking distance, and you can access all social areas according to your preferences.

I can help my guests with 24/7 reception service to keep your comfort at the top, where they can stay like their own home.

reviews.text:
We had a great stay. The apartment was exactly as described : clean, comfortable, with an elevator, good heating, and a well-equipped kitchen. The location is excellent, just a short walk from the Tophane tram station, which made getting around Istanbul very easy.
The reception staff were very kind and helpful throughout our stay. I also highly recommend trying the Turkish traditional breakfast at the hotel, it was delicious.
Overall, a very good experience. I would definitely stay here again.

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was very convenient, and everything we needed was available. The host was friendly, responsive, and very helpful throughout our stay.
We really enjoyed our time here and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area. We would happily stay here again!
The place looks exactly like photos. Great location and amazing front desk staff, very helpful. Having the kitchen was great. Would stay here again. Comfortable bed!

İstanbul'u gezmek için 3 gece eşim, 12 ve 9 yaşındaki iki oğlumla 4 kişi olarak konakladık.İlk defa Airbnb'den konaklama yaptık. Ev sahibi Fatih Bey çok ilgiliydi ve her sorumuzu cevapladı.Resepsiyon,cafe çalışanları çok nazikti.Oda ilandaki fotoğrafların aynısıydı,çok temizdi. Eşyalar yeni ve yıpranmamıştı. Salonda ve yatak odasında ayrı klima vardı ve tavandaki konumları yataklara direk hava üflemiyordu. Gece çocukların odasındaki klimayı rahatlıkla açık bıraktık. Konum olarak çok iyi yerde bulunuyor. Çift yönlü araç trafiği olan büyük bir cadde de. Çevresinde tüm ihtiyaçlarımızı karşıladığımız 100 metre mesafede eczane, börekçi, market,restoran, tarihi simitçi, kasap vardı. Galata kulesine ve istiklal caddesine 600 metre, tophane tramvay durağına 250 metre mesafede. Biz iki çoçukla gezdiğimizden dolayı 3-4 saat gezdikten sonra otele geri döndük, biraz dinlendikten sonra tekrar çıktık. Sultanahmet ve istiklal caddesine bakarak otelin olduğu caddedeki restoranlar yarı yarıya uygundu.

This is a hotel located in one of the best locations in town, you are literally 100 meters from the public transport that within few stops will take you to Istanbul’s heart. The area is very secure and with lots of shops and restaurants around. The room is super spacious and with all the facilities described. Downstairs is a great cafeteria and you can explore, return, take a siesta and comeback and explore some more.
The communication was very clear and super fast. I will definitely comeback.

description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay. Our place is located in a bustling area with a shopping mall, restaurants and cafes, beauty salons, and a mosque nearby. You'll be able to enjoy the convenience of having everything you need within walking distance. Our home is cozy and comfortable, with all the amenities you need for a relaxing stay. We look forward to hosting you!

reviews.text: This was a great apartment with a great view of the city at night. Location was close to restaurants, grocery store and malls. The amenities are nice. The host was easy and quick to communicate with. The parking was convenient and secure, overall, we enjoyed our stay.
Evin dizaynı, olanakları,temizliği, düzeni ve ev sahibinin ilgisi anlamında memnun kaldığım ve tercih ettiğim güzel bir konaklama..
Her şey tatlı güzeldi. Görseller ve ev aynı. Konumu merkezi sayılır her yere gidebildik. Teşekkürler
Very responsive and helpful staff, apartments match the description, easy to communicate and flexible check-ins. I enjoyed the stay!

Great place! Great view and awesome in general. In case of transportation, there are these yellow vans which stop in front of the place so that you can get to the metrobus. Supermarkets very close by and great security.

description:
In a prime location in Istanbul, POPSTEL provides air-conditioned rooms, a garden, free WiFi and a terrace. Featuring a bar, the hotel is close to several noted attractions, around a 9-minute walk from Istiklal Street, 0.6 miles from Taksim Square and a 13-minute walk from Taksim Metro Station.
At the hotel, the rooms come with a desk. With a private fully equipped bathroom, POPSTEL also provide guests with a city view. At the accommodation all rooms are equipped with bed linen and towels.

reviews.text:
Good location and easy to reach.
Located 5 minutes away from itsikal street so you have access to a min market.
Host was amazing, accommodation and helpful. Always reachable and adaptive to our content changing flights due to bad weather and late check in.
The accommodating had two floors to climb within a narrow staircase so you need to keep that in mind Incase you have big bags
Accommodation has very basic amenities unlike other usual air bnbs so keep that in mind too. It’s fantastic if you just want to rest for the night and spend most of the day outdoors.
What can be better:
- better room lighting.
- cleaner floor and sheets
- washroom doors - water sprays out when you have a shower.
- a few more amenities would be nice

Popstel was great - stylish decor, fun bar downstairs and perfect location. Room was large, comfortable and clean, and really good value for money. Our only downside was that we felt the drinks in the bar were on the expensive side and the staff weren’t super friendly (but maybe we caught them when they were busy). Other than that it was a great stay and we would recommend to friends visiting Istanbul.

tam bir fiyat performans konaklama seçeneği, bu konaklamanın en güzel yanı konumuydu. bir çok yere yürüyerek ulaşabilirsiniz, toplu ulaşım araçlarına da bu konumdan kolaylıkla ulaşabilirsiniz. check-in&out süreçleri de oldukça kolaydı, ev sahibi siz oraya varmadan her şeyi detaylıca açıklıyor. bulunduğu konum gereği gece&gündüz gürültülü, eğer gürültü hassasiyetiniz varsa bu seçenek size uygun olmayacaktır ama Beyoğlu’nda gürültüsüz bir yer bulmakta mucize olsa gerek. beyoğlu’nun tadını çıkarmak için çok güzel bir konaklama seçeneği.

Great location, very convenient for getting around the city. The staff was friendly and helpful throughout our stay. I also really liked the place on the ground floor—nice vibe, great for a drink or a bite. The accommodation was clean and cozy. Overall, a great stay—I’d definitely come back
All the important things were right - a comfortable bed, a good large shower, good hairdryer, chairs in the room. Flexible hosts

description: This home is ideal for travelers looking to balance city exploration with tranquil comfort. Whether you’re enjoying a barbecue on the veranda, watching a movie on the large-screen TV, or sipping coffee with a Bosphorus breeze, this property promises a memorable Istanbul stay.

reviews.text: Very comfortable apartment in a quiet location. The friendly host, Mert, always responded quickly and was attentive to a kitchen mishap that occurred. As others have noted, the streets around the apartment are hilly and steep, so not for the faint-hearted. I was able to find on-street parking nearby, although that can be more difficult in the evening.

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment! The space itself was fantastic - really comfortable and well-equipped. The big TV was perfect for relaxing in the evenings, and we absolutely loved the terrace. It was such a nice spot to enjoy our morning coffee and unwind after exploring the area.
The only thing to be aware of is that the apartment is located on a hill. It wasn't a dealbreaker for us, but it's worth noting if you have mobility concerns or will be walking back frequently. We got our exercise in, that's for sure!

Merit was great, the apartment was clean and had everything we needed except matches to start the gas stove. It was nicely decorated and close to the Bosporus. We only had two issues that under normal circumstances would maybe not be a problem. Be aware you have to carry luggage down multiple flights of stairs, outside and also in the building itself. Inside the apartment was great but in the halls leading to it smelled of sewage. Getting to the apartment by taxi was difficult for us only because it was either raining or snowing the entire stay. The steep, slippery cobblestone roads made it very difficult for cabs to find their way up and would often lose traction and slide down the hill. The drivers would get frustrated and have us get out and walk with our stuff to get to our place and the walk was not easy as the road was slippery and very steep. If you are an older couple I would not recommend this place but if young and the weather is good then it is great.
Great place, clean and exactly like the photos.

Mert bey'in evinde 2 hafta konakladım.Ev oldukça güzel donatılmış,modern ve zevkli tasarımlara sahipti.1+1 bir ev için oldukça geniş ve ferah yaşam alanları mevcut.2 adet özellikle yaz ve bahar dönemlerinde keyifle kullanılabilecek verandalara sahip olan bu evde oldukça güzel zaman geçirdim.Maksimum 3 kişilik yatak alanı mevcuttur.Mert bey zaten bu durumu açıklamada belirtmişti.Ev ile ilgili yapılabilecek tek eleştri evin konumuyla ilgilidir.Bu da önceden durum göz önünde bulundurulduğunda zaten bir sorun olmaktan çıkar.Ev Ortaköy'ün yokuşlarında yer alır.Evin girişi uzun bir merdivene sahiptir.Araç bulmak bu alanda zordur.Ayrıca elverişli bir aracınız yoksa bu sorun olabilir.Ancak evden oldukça memnun kaldığımı belirtmek isterim.Teşekkür ederim.

description: Enjoy easy access to popular historical sites and restaurants from this charming accommodation.

reviews.text: Fantastic stay! The room was very clean and the overall service amazing. The location couldn’t have been better. The host, Mustafa, was very welcoming and helpful, which made the experience even better. I would definitely recommend this place for anyone looking for a comfortable and hassle free stay.

This little hotel is in the heart of Sultanahmet and so walkable to some of the main tourist attractions of Istanbul including the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Basilica Cistern and the Grand Bazar. I could see the Blue Mosque from my room on one side and the sea on the other. Although it was so close to all these things it is tucked away just enough that the street is relatively quiet and feels like an oasis compared to the business of the tourist crowds. The area for breakfast is on the top floor and offers an amazing view of the sea.
The host was great. There was a mix up with my room the first night which wasn’t a problem for me and I was offered a free shuttle to the airport or a river cruise for the inconvenience. I also ran out of time to mail my postcards when I left and the host offered to mail them for me which was very greatly appreciated.
For the price you cannot beat the location, hospitality and free breakfast. Bonus that there is a small convenience store right next door.

This hotel is safe, clean, and in a pristine location for tourist attractions and shopping. The views are epic and the breakfast is very good! Mustafa is an attentive host who addressed all of my needs and concerns. He gave me a map and some great suggestions. I will return to Istanbul because of my experiences stemming from staying at the Emine Sultan Hotel.

I really enjoyed my stay here in Istanbul. The location of the hotel was only a 5 minute walk away from Sultanahmet Square and many of the main attractions. The hotel itself was nice, the rooms were tidy, and the breakfast was enjoyable with a pleasant view. Mustafa was very responsive and quickly addressed the questions and concerns I had!
Works great - breakfast included, very responsive and helpful staff. Nicer than a hostel with a private bedroom and bathroom but does not break the bank.

description:
ALEX - Located in the center of KADIKÖY. The center is only a few steps away from Moda and the Rıhtıma (Port). You can walk to the Seaside in 1 minute. Our apartment has well-equipped new furniture. We try to think of everything for your comfort.

Entertainment Centers are Here

reviews.text: Gayet güzel bi konumda temiz ve ulaşımı çok rahattı.

İçerisi tam temizlenmemiş, verilen suların yarısı içilmiş, yerler ve havlular kirli, bu anlamda verdiğim paranın asla karşılığını alamadım 500 tl bile etmezdi. Ama konum iyi merkezi yapacak bir çok şey var. Civarda kalacaklara asla tavsiye etmiyorum.

Serpil Hanım’a teşekkür ediyorum. Evin konumu ve temizliği çok iyiydi. Jakuzi sıcak su gibi konularda bir sorun yaşamadık. Sadece daire içinde boya ve alçı döküntüleri var. Çok bir sorun yaşatmıyor ama görüntü açısından ve çevreye dökülen toz açısından kötüydü.
Genel olarak çok memnun kaldık
Konum, temizlik ve ilgi gayet iyiydi. Fakat kaldığımız yerle alakalı ısınma sorunu vardı, onun haricinde tavsiye ederim.

Genel olarak memnun kaldık. Ev sahini sorularımıza hep çok hızlı yanıt verdi. Klima kumandası çalışmayınca pilinin bitmiş olacağını düşündük. 5 dakika sonra kapımızda pillerle gelmişlerdi, teşekkür ederiz. Konum olarak da gayet güzeldi.

description: PeraHomes

reviews.text: The hosts were very helpful and assisted us with everything. The place was exactly as described, and we were very satisfied with our stay. Highly recommended!

The accommodation is in a great location. Tourist attractions are easily accessible. However, the room itself is very small and has no window facing the street. On Sundays, there's a market outside, but you can't hear the noise (since there's no window). Also, people rattling suitcases in the hallways in the morning can interfere with sleep. If you only need the accommodation for sleeping and plan to walk around during the day, this is a great option.

Nice location, the bus station is just at the top of the street. Very easy to go anywhere from there. And Taksim square is just crossing the street.
It feels very local.
Not great for lonely girl travellers, I won’t go out that late or come back very late, there’s always men outside and they way they look at you is very uncomfortable.
all was clean and comfortable room and place to stay like its your home you will never feel you are new with them thanks to all of them i will come again
fotoğraflarda görüldüğü gibiydi, harici bir şey yoktu. biraz küçük ve havalandırma yetersiz kalıyor ama fiyat performans için mükemmel

description:
The authentic bay window suite is located in Taksim, the heart of Beyoğlu, within walking distance to Galataport and Karaköy, one of the liveliest areas of Istanbul

With 24/7 transportation, you can easily reach every corner of the city and discover shopping, entertainment, coastal walks and places with Bosphorus views in minutes

I provide comfort and 24/7 reception support where my guests can feel at home

There is also a terrace with a view of the Bosphorus in the common area within the facility

reviews.text:
This is a great hotel for seeing the sites and for restaurants and bars close by.
It is in a great location for getting around easily on foot and public transport.
The hosts/reception staff were always super friendly and helpful. Let us leave our luggage on the last day after checkout and it’s 24 hr access.
For the price I think it is great value for money.
It is in the heart of everything which is what we wanted. We didn’t spend lots of time in the hotel as we were in Istanbul for 4 days and wanted to see as much as possible. So it was perfect for us. It’s probably not the quietest sleep you’ll have but I don’t think you’d find anywhere peaceful in this location. Just general city street noises and it certainly isn’t a particularly busy street but if you are sensitive to noise bring ear plugs. This is not a negative to the hotel - just a tip for staying centrally In Istanbul if you’re coming from a quiet neighbourhood.
The room we had was spacious, well equipped and clean.

The room is in a well-kept hostel-like building where there is a shared kitchen area, yet everyone has private bedrooms and bathrooms. There were a few cool seating/lounging areas in the building as well as a cool little roof-top area. The people at the reception were always very nice and helpful.
Location is great— close to the main rail-car, but off of the main streets so that you can get a vibe of the city more and the cute shops. Everything was very walkable.
The room had a great AC unit, which was nice to have, it had a cool vide, and had everything that one needs.

I absolutely loved my stay at Fatih’s place! The location couldn’t be better , it’s right in the heart of Istanbul, close to all the major tourist attractions, restaurants, and cafes. The room was comfortable and clean, and the people at the reception were always available, kind, and incredibly helpful throughout my stay. I’d definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul and would love to stay here again!

The location is very good, you are close to all important marks, and close to public transport.
The bathroom was cleaned but not thoroughly and there was some limescale in the bathroom.
The common spaces are not as clean as I imagined and give a hostel vibe, and there is rust on the radiator in the kitchen. I understand the building is old but some renovations are needed. (Walls, radiator).
Overall, it was a good stay, and the hosts were nice, just that there are a few points for improvement which I mentioned.

Konum olarak harika,iletişimleri sorunsuz ve yardıma açık arkadaşlar.Terası mükemmel.Odayı temiz bulduk fakat yerler yeni silindiği için fazla temizlik malzemesi kokuyordu ve havasızdı.Çift kişilik yatak olması gerektiğini düşünüyorduk,tek kişilik iki yatak birleştirilmişti gece geç vakitte farkettiğimiz için geri bildirim yapmadık.Çift için oldukça rahatsızdı.Dikkate alacaklarını düşünüyorum.Bunun dışında her şey yolundaydı.

description:
Luxury Accommodation with Panoramic Sea and City Views

Experience the perfect blend of history and modern comfort in this stylish apartment, offering breathtaking panoramic sea and city views. Just minutes away from popular neighborhoods and historical landmarks, discover a new way of life with this stunning view as your backdrop.

reviews.text: I stayed 3 nights for a short city trip. The location is 30 minutes from Istanbul airport and yet close to downtown (Taksim & Sultanahmet). Apartment is in a prestigious high-rise building. Views from the apartment are stunning. The apartment is clean, comfy & with all basic amenities. The host is polite, friendly & responds very quickly. There is an on-site supermarket on the ground floor.
Only stayed one night, but the apartment is super nice and modern. Very clean, modern, and lots of amenities. Zapata was very communicative and flexible with our check in/out times. :)

Çok sayıda konaklama yaptım hiçbirinde burada yaşadığım kadar kötü olaylar içerisinde bulunmadım. Öncelikle fotoğrafta kiraladığım odada kalmadık başka birine ait başka bir odada kaldık son dakika klimalarda problem olduğunu söylediler ancak konaklamamızın ikinci gününde bizim kiraladığımız yerde başka birinin bulunduğunu öğrendik. Yer başka birine ait olduğu için boş sandığımda ev sahibi eve anahtarı ile giriş sağladı ne olduğunu şaşırdık. Ev inanılmaz pisti. Bulaşık makinesi bozuktu su sızdırıyordu. Yetkili arkadaşa sorunlarımızı iletmek için neredeyse ulaşamadık hatta bir telefon görüşmesinde telefonu yüzümüze kapattı. Bize verilen kart tuttuğunuz odaya aitti ancak biz orada kalmadığımız için giriş çıkışlarda sürekli güvenlikten yardım almak zorunda kaldık. Komşular çok fazla gürültü yapıyor ve maalesef çok değişik tipte insanlar var binada. Asıl yetkili arkadaş konaklamamızın ikinci gününde bizimle iletişime geçip kısmi bir parayı iadesi yapsa da konaklamamızın ilk iki günü zehirdi

Great location—pharmacy and supermarket in the building, and the building felt super safe. The host was really responsive when the fuse blew and fixed it right away. Only downside was some loud neighbors at night. Overall, a solid stay!
Thanks, everything was amazing) so beautiful so clean apartament and very nice location

description: The last thing you should worry about is your comfort on a holiday. Rappel Suite No.4 has anything you need for a pleasant stay even the full Bosphorus view. Located in the center of the beautiful Istanbul City. 5 min walk to Taksim Square, 5 min walk down to the Kabataş Boat Station, Karaköy tram that takes 10 mins to the old city Sultanahmet. But the real city feeling to experience in the evening is just 3 min walk. The best bars and restaurants of the city are right behind the corner.

reviews.text: Ali was super responsive and shared some good recommendations. He was communicative with us and helped us out with a couple requests. The room was just as pictured. The view from the room is beautiful. The apartment is secure & we felt safe being there. The is an elevator which was perfect. The only thing I would say is the floors need to be cleaned better. But everything else was super clean. The bed & pillows were clean but not really comfy. However, the blanket was clean, warm, and comfy. The water pressure in the bathroom was great. The location is close to Taksim & Istiklal street. There are 3 coffee shops literally right outside the apartment so it was very easy to grab coffee and a pastry in the morning. I recommend the coffee shop at the end of the street next to the shop called Garage Sale that is attached to the apartment complex- it was the best of 3 coffee shops in my opinion. The apartment is also really close to restaurants and shops. Thanks for a great stay!

Okay, I’ve stayed at a lot of Airbnbs over the years, and this one genuinely stands out. Might actually be the best one I’ve ever booked.
The view is incredible — the kind where you just sit there with your morning coffee doing nothing, and that’s fine. Location is spot on, easy to get around, close to everything.
The host was great. Quick replies, helpful without being overbearing. You know how some hosts you never hear from, and others micromanage? This was neither — just right.
The place was super clean. Like, properly clean, not “looks okay at first glance” clean. And what surprised me was the attention to detail. The furniture, kitchen stuff, even towels and bedding — all thoughtfully chosen. Nothing cheap or random. Someone put real effort into making this place nice to live in, not just look good in photos.
It had everything we needed. I don’t think there was a single moment where something was missing.
Would absolutely book again. Highly recommend.

The apartment is exactly as described and as in pictures. I think the view of bosphorous is even better then pictures. Couldn’t be at better location. Very clean very comfortable place. Worth every penny 🙏👏

This apartment is objectively beautiful. Clean, functional, with lots of amenities, and a view which is probably unparalleled of the long bridge over the Bosphorus and Cihangir Park. At a good price too. We would have stayed here for months if we had the time. Lots of good restaurants nearby; walking distance from lots of historical sites, shopping, and more; fairly close to various forms of public transport. A perfect place from where to start your discovery of Istanbul. One of the best AirBNB's I've every stayed in. Sina was also very helpful and responsive. Ideal host.

Ali’s place was incredible - it truly felt like home. Everything was brand new, and we were so impressed by the quality of the cookware, silverware, and even the reverse osmosis filter so we never had to buy water. The lighting was perfect, the Wi-Fi super fast, the shower excellent, and the bed incredibly comfortable. The washer was also new and easy to use. The view was breathtaking, with the entire bridge and lively park below - it was a joy to watch. The location couldn’t be better, surrounded by wonderful cafes, restaurants, boutique shops, and upscale groceries. The apartment was spotless; we couldn’t find a single flaw. On top of that, Ali was so responsive, kind, and accommodating with our needs. I absolutely loved it and will be back! We have visited Istanbul for months at a time, several times now, and this was easily the best apartment we have stayed at. Thanks for everything!

description: Enjoy a peaceful and central stay in this spacious flat featuring a private courtyard, located just 350 meters from Taksim Square and right next to the German Consulate’s garden. Recently renovated in 2019, this home is perfect for couples, friends, or families looking for comfort, calm, and easy access to everything Istanbul has to offer.

reviews.text: I stayed here with my mom & my 2 year old son. Very spacious, the crib was a great addition. There were a few issues for starters the “hot water”, upon arrival the water wouldn’t get hot at all. The host responded very quickly and sent maintenance over to fix it. One of the bathrooms shower head didn’t work & he tried to fix it but had to end up coming back. The hot water didn’t last for 3 people to shower, so you had to continue to wait for the water to get hot again. Also on one of the nights someone tried to get into the home at around 2am could’ve been a complete apartment mix up but we still don’t know, never got to see camera footage. Very quiet area overall, That was very scary and we were gonna move air bnbs with 2 nights left of our stay but couldn’t find anything close so we propped a chair up to the door. Walking distance to very nice restaurants with beautiful views and shopping not far either. Perfect space for families however the hot water was a major disappointment.

Okan's place is really comfortable and clean, very quiet but right next to a lively neighbourhood! Very close to Taksim Square from which one can go any direction with little hassle (funicular, metro, ferry, trains...). Istiqlal Avenue, one of the most popular roads, starts there, one can stroll, have an ice-cream or a durum very easily...
Really lovely place and amazing host, will definitely go back!
Thank you again Okan

Harika bir konumda, tertemiz bir 2 banyolu, 2 yatak odalı daire. Her türlü ev eşyası var. Kendimi kesinlikle evimde hissettim. Okan ve Harun Beyler çok ilgililer.
Dairenin bulunduğu bölge sessiz, güzel bir gece uykusu için ideal ki bu benim için önemliydi. Aynı zamanda Taksim, Gümüşsuyu ve Cihangir’e de çok yakın. Herkese tavsiye ederim.

We had a great stay and were very pleased with the apartment. The location is excellent – very close to Taksim Square, Istiklal Avenue, and Dolmabahçe Palace, with easy access to all kinds of transport from Kabataş and Taksim.
The apartment itself is spacious, with two bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a lovely yard. It is well-equipped with everything needed for a comfortable stay.
The host was very kind, responsive, and always helpful.
We highly recommend this place and would gladly stay here again!

A very nice and cozy apartment, very close to Taksim Square - 5 minutes walk - and Kabataș station - 15 minutes walk - and Okan was a great host. Fast check-in - we found the key in the lockbox. Unfortunatelly there are no place for your car, so you should let it in a paid parking.
Anyway, the place is great and the garden is a perfect spot for your morning coffee.

description: Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this centrally located, quiet place.

reviews.text:
Last minute booking and Veysel was very accommodating and helpful. He communicated well and was very responsive. Did not have to wait more than a couple of minutes for a response.
The apartment was lovely and even though the bedroom and bathroom were small, they were functional. One of the reason I chose this apartment was the availability of a washing machine. We have been traveling for a while so washing our clothes were much needed. The machine was clean and laundry powder was provided.
There’s steps to get to the first floor where a small elevator begins.
Lots of restaurants nearby with decent prices. There’s also a corner shop right across for snacks and water.
When we were making the bed on day of check out, we saw that the front of the mattress, it was burnt. Msged Veysel to inform. This prolly happened previously due to being too close to the radiator.
Very responsive host, everything was amazing, the property was so clean and exactly like the photos. Will definitely stay here again.

Everything was fine, there was no hot water when I arrived but the host sent someone to fix it and it was resolved quickly. The neighbourhood can be a bit noisy during the weekend but its fine otherwise.
Perfect location, clean and modern. Great value, definitely would recommend! 10/10 :)
The location is fantastic! Apartment amazing and very comfortable! I highly recommend!

description:
Conveniently set in Istanbul, Homelike Hotel provides air-conditioned rooms, a restaurant and free WiFi. The property is located 2 km from Istiklal Street. The accommodation features a 24-hour front desk.

All units at the hotel are equipped with a TV with satellite channels and a safety deposit box. The private bathroom is equipped with a shower, free toiletries and a hairdryer. At Hotel each room include towels

Popular points of interest near the accommodation include Istanbul Taksim Square.

description: Enjoy easy access to popular shops and restaurants from this charming place to stay.

reviews.text:
I stayed at Saleh’s place for almost 3 weeks and it was a wonderful experience. Saleh was incredibly supportive and responsive the whole time, any question I had, he replied quickly.
The apartment was clean, comfortable, and in a great location, just a short walk to Taksim Square. I really enjoyed staying here and would 100% recommend it. Thank you Saleh!

Not a bad place to stay in. Close to Taksim and easily found. The host is responsive and helpful. I wish the bed had better comforter and bed sheets. And washroom is a little smelly. Otherwise room is clean.

I was in parahomes Airbnb but couldn’t stay was dirty bathroom was not functional had to book last minute and sukru let me checked in 20 mints and when I asked for extra clean up he showed up next day . The location is amazing close to Taksim square walkable distance to restaurant bus and metro over all it’s worth staying here

Good place and close to Taksim (5 minutes walk)
Studio was clean and neighborhood is also good.
We feel secure in this place.
Host was also very flexible for late checkout.
I recommend this place!!

Quick check-in, spacious room with a small, beautiful view of Istanbul. My dislikes upon arrival: dirty toilet, thick layer of dust on the cabinets, balcony table soaked with cigarette soot, staining clothes when touched.

description: Welcome to your modern city retreat! This bright and thoughtfully designed 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom home offers the perfect blend of comfort and creativity in the heart of Ortakoy. Set on a charming hillside in a vibrant neighborhood, you're just minutes away from local cafes, shops, and public transport. The area offers an authentic taste of local life while staying close to city highlights. Ideal for couples, solo travelers, or remote workers looking for a fresh and functional stay in Istanbul.

One of the best Airbnb stays I’ve ever had! The host was incredibly professional, kind, and communicative throughout our entire stay. Everything was perfect, and we truly felt welcomed and comfortable. I sincerely hope we get the chance to stay here again in the future. Highly recommended!
