Un séjour tout simplement parfait !
Nous avons passé des jours inoubliables dans cet appartement. L’hébergement est impeccable : tout est propre, bien rangé, et parfaitement équipé. Rien ne manque, tout est pensé pour le confort des voyageurs.
L’emplacement est idéal, à proximité des points d’intérêt, tout en étant calme et agréable. Et que dire de la vue… à couper le souffle !
Mais ce qui a vraiment fait la différence, c’est la qualité de la communication avec les hôtes. Ultra réactifs, attentionnés et toujours disponibles, ils ont su rendre notre séjour encore plus agréable.
Un grand merci pour votre accueil et votre gentillesse. Nous reviendrons sans hésiter chez vous lors de notre prochain passage. À très bientôt !

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
I cannot say enough good things about our stay! 10/10 in every way. We’ve jumped around to a few different areas and stays throughout Turkey, and this was hands down one of the best. It is truly a hidden gem!
The location is amazing. You’re right in the middle of what feels like a charming little town/market area in Italy, with so many shops, markets, and places to explore nearby. The area felt very safe, and the location is central and makes it incredibly easy to get around.
The place itself was VERY clean, comfortable, and the air conditioning worked amazingly—which was definitely appreciated! The host also went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of during our stay, which meant so much to me.
My only complaint is that I wish I had found this place sooner! 😂 I’m so grateful that I now have a go-to place that is affordable, comfortable, and truly top-tier whenever I’m in Turkey.
Absolutely recommend—10/10!
Very clean and comfortable place. Host is very responsive and helpful. Location is very good, everything is just within walking distance.

Balatside Hotel’de geçirdiğimiz konaklamadan son derece memnun kaldık. Otel çok temiz, odalar modern ve konforluydu. Personel inanılmaz derecede güler yüzlü, ilgili ve her konuda yardımcı olmaya hazırdı. Kendimizi evimizde gibi hissettik.
Konumu da harikaydı. Balat’ın tarihi ve renkli sokaklarına, kafelerine ve turistik noktalarına yürüyerek kolayca ulaşabildik. Sessiz ve huzurlu bir ortamda dinlenirken, şehrin keyfini çıkarmak da çok kolaydı.
Temizlik, hizmet kalitesi ve misafirperverlik beklentilerimizin çok üzerindeydi. İstanbul’u ziyaret edecek herkese Balatside Hotel’i gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim. Tekrar İstanbul’a geldiğimizde kesinlikle burada konaklayacağız. Her şey için çok teşekkür ederiz!

Mükemmel bir konaklama deneyimi oldu bizim için. Ben ve ailem için her türlü beklentimizi karşıladı. Ev sahibine ilgi ve alakası için teşekkür ederim. Yurt dışında çeşitli lokasyonlarda konaklamiş biri olarak standartları yüksek bir konaklama olduğunu söyleyebilirim. Eşyalar yeni kullanışlı ve temizdi. Konum olarak otantik şirin bir muhit. Her türlü ihtiyacınızı kolayca giderebilirsiniz.
Konaklama yeri fotoğraftaki gibiydi , temiz bir şekilde teslim edildi , ev sahipleri gayet kibar ve misafirperverdi.

description:
The apartment with a balcony is located in one of the most tourist-attracting districts in the world, in the center of Beyoğlu, within walking distance to Karaköy coast, Taksim Square and Galataport.

It is in an area where 24/7 transportation is easily available, you can reach all personal needs within walking distance, and you can access all social areas according to your preferences.

I offer you a space where you can stay and feel like you are at home

reviews.text:
We stay for a week there.
What is good:
* really clean space
* good location in downtown
* great communication with host
* comfortable bed
What is have to be improved:
* we met ants in the room and host told us to use spray
*the next day he invited exterminator. We’d have to wait for their visit. I think it is better to call them before guests check in.
* they left some powder on the floor of the whole apartment - this could be risky for kids and animals
* some kitchen stuff looks broken or old
* some scratches and spots on the walls.
Other peculiarity’s:
* narrow stages to the second floor - not for seniors and disabled people
* hills in the neighborhood- it is Istanbul, no flat places
* mosque starts praying it 4:00 am with a huge noise
* cruise ships in a Galataport was beeping in a random time
* roster screaming all the time on a street.
It is really noisy to sleep.

Very convenient location. Just a few blocks from a tram/bus station. Plenty of grocery stores and good restaurants in the area. The building is in a quiet block though.
The apartment is very good. The bedroom and the living room are of a good size and comfortable. The king size bed is a plus. The bathroom is also very good and has washer. The kitchen is a little small but still good. It also has a small balcony.
It is important to be aware that the stairs to get to the apartment in the second are very steep, so if you have heavy luggage and have mobility problems it may be a challenge.
The host is very helpful and responsive.
The apartment is definitely a good base to visit Istanbul.

Faith’s apartment is clean and tidy, with complete amenities. It has a large living room and bedroom, plus a small kitchen, balcony, and bathroom. The sofa in the living room can be pulled out into a bed—perfect for lying down and watching TV comfortably. We had a truly memorable stay here.
Within about a ten-minute walk, you’ll find subway and tram stations, as well as several large supermarkets, making it very convenient for buying food and daily necessities. The appliances, like the washing machine, only have Turkish labels, but you can use ChatGPT for guidance. We’d suggest the host provide some instructions for the apartment’s facilities. Istanbul has many winding side streets, so first-time visitors should pay close attention to directions when arriving.

We had a pleasant stay at Fatih’s place. The apartment was cozy, had everything we needed, and the air conditioning was especially appreciated during the hot Istanbul summer. The location is very convenient, within walking distance of the tram, metro, Galataport, and Istiklal/Taksim. Fatih was easy to communicate with and helped arrange our airport transfer, which made our trip more convenient. Overall, a good place to stay.

I had a wonderful stay at the apartment. It is very spacious, stylish, and perfectly clean. It has everything you need, which also makes it perfect for longer stays.
The internet is fast and works flawlessly, so I was able to work without any issues during my time there. There’s also a lovely balcony — perfect for enjoying a coffee.
Whenever I had a question, I could contact Fatih at any time. He replied immediately and was very friendly and helpful. Thank you, Fatih — I really enjoyed my stay.

description: Stay in a stylish, light-filled high-ceiling studio with a beautiful French balcony, perfectly located on charming Eski Çiçekçi Street—just a 1-minute walk from Istiklal Avenue. This unique space blends modern comfort with classic Beyoğlu character, offering a warm and inspiring atmosphere for your stay.

reviews.text: Umut is a friendly and always ready to help Host. The room was clean, everything mentioned was provided. Had some issues with the hot water and the heating but Umut helped immediately. Because of the location, it was quiet, which is not common in Instabul, from what I was told by friends who chose other places to stay. Perfect for a good nights sleep! Really close to everything and I, as a solo traveler, felt safe.

Umutun evi tamamen fotoğraflarda gözüktüğü gibi ve herşey söylenildiği gibiydi ev temiz ve İstiklal caddesine bir iki dakikalık mesafelik uzaklıkta. Restoranlar eğlence mekanları tarihi yerler ve deniz evin konumu mükemmel. Hem konum itibariyle hem evin temizliği ve rahatlığı hem de çevrenin güvenli olması nedeniyle tekrar tercih edeceğiz. Herşey için teşekkürler.

2 gece konakladım. Umut Bey gerçekten kusursuz bir ev sahibi. Sizi rahat ettirmek için elinden geleni değil, fazlasını yapıyor. Oda tertemizdi, ihtiyaç duyabileceğiniz her detay en ince ayrıntısına kadar düşünülmüş. Konumu ise harika; İstiklal’e sadece 3 dakikalık yürüyüş mesafesinde ama buna rağmen bulunduğu sokak son derece sakin ve gürültüden tamamen uzak. İstanbul’a tekrar geldiğimde başka bir yer aramak aklımdan bile geçmez; direkt hiç düşünmeden yine burayı tercih ederim. Hatta keşke her şehirde böyle bir ev sahibi olsa dedirtiyor.

fiyatına göre bence iyi değil. mutfak araç gereçleri kirliydi. balkon yok. oda beklediğimden küçük. bir kaç yerde saç vardı. çok eski bi binaydı. çelik kapı yamuluyordu. duş başlığı sabitlenmiyordu ki en sinir bozan da buydu. birde sabah çıkış saati erken. manzara güzel ama eğilmen lazım kolay bi manzara değil. çakışan ilgiliydi ama teşekkür ederiz. konumu da bence gayet iyi. filtre kahve makinesi de hoşdu.

Şimdiye kadar geçirdiğim en iyi airbnb deneyimiydi.Oda resimde görüldüğü gibi ve çok temizdi ısıtması da çok iyiydi.Konum zaten harika.Hiçbir sorun yaşamadık ayrıca çalışan çok ilgiliydi.Ev sahibi de öyle.

description: Discover Istanbul from our spacious 2-bedroom, ground-floor apartment, perfect for families and groups of up to 6. With no stairs, A/C, and high-speed WiFi, comfort is guaranteed. Located in the historic heart, you're just a short walk from the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, and Grand Bazaar. Your ideal base for exploring the city's magic!

reviews.text: The place was exactly like the description. We truly enjoyed our stay. Average home, small, cozy, very suitable for the price. My family of 5 had just enough room and it was awesome having a washer and amazing internet! Lots of tourist attractions nearby and a super walkable area. We also had no trouble contacting the host. He was very kind and would respond no matter the time of day. He can also arrange transportation if needed.

Emre was a wonderful host and made our stay in Istanbul very comfortable. He was extremely responsive, clear and helpful throughout our stay, and everything was exactly as described. We had a fantastic time and would happily stay here again. Highly recommended!

You’re right at the center of touristic Istanbul, walking distance to all main attractions.
The apartment is on the 1st floor. It’s very comfortable for 2-4 people. Host is very friendly and responsive.

The house is within minutes' walking distance to some main tourist attractions, such as hippodrome, blue mosque, Hagia Sophia Grand Mosque, Topkapi Palace, etc. The kitchen has apparently better furnishing than some other Airbnb houses that I see when searching online. There is even a laundry washer in the kitchen. The contact or manager Emre responds to us fair quickly and was postured to improvement at my comments. I appreciate his offering of two free airport transfers as a friendly gesture to little inconvenience we experienced that he later delt with immediately. I heard him say we, two couples, were the first customers after the house's entry into Airbnb network. Would recommend this house if the rental price meets the traveller's budget.

5minutes walking distance to Blue Mosque & Ayasofia. A bit small for us that have 6 xl size of luggage but overall its fine as Emru had more option of houses but at the moment when we’re there all are occupied.
Emru is a good host and very responsive & helpful. Definitely will comeback and stay again.
Many access to tram station & choices of restaurants plenty with good surroundings.

description:
A Dreamy Stay with Unique Comfort and Istanbul View at Ottomare

Get ready to stay in the Ottomare residence, which embraces the fascinating blue of the Sea of Marmara in the heart of Istanbul. Combining modern architecture, luxurious details and holiday comfort with everyday life, this private apartment is designed to offer its guests a unique experience for both short-term visits and long stays.

One of the most attractive features of the apartment is its balcony with sea views.

24/7 security

reviews.text: Her İstanbul ziyaretimde kalmak isteyeceğim bir yer oldu. Deniz manzarası gerçekten fotoğraflardan daha güzel görünüyor. Ev çok sıcak bir atmosfere sahipti ve insan kendini yabancı hissetmiyor. Konumu da oldukça avantajlı.

İstanbul’da kaldığım en rahat yerlerden biri oldu diyebilirim. Balkon manzarası harikaydı ve evin içinde ihtiyaç duyulan her şey vardı. Özellikle temizliği ve düzeni beni çok memnun etti. Uzun süre kalınabilecek konforlu bir yer.

Resul Bey harika bir ev sahibi. Ev fotogtaflarda gosterildigi gibi, hic bir eksik yok. Temizlik mukemmeldi. Kendisi her soruma usenmeden oncesinde ve sonrasinda cevap verdi. Dusunmeden kiralama yapabilirsiniz.
Tertemiz ferah ve güzel daire, herşey yolundaydı.

Konaklamam boyunca hiçbir sorun yaşamadım. Ev hem çok ferah hem de oldukça kullanışlıydı. Deniz manzarası özellikle akşamları inanılmaz güzel oluyor. Sessiz, huzurlu ve güven veren bir ortamı vardı. Ev sahibi de her konuda çok ilgiliydi.

description:
Stylish 1-Bedroom Apartment in the Heart of the City

Enjoy a comfortable stay in this modern 1-bedroom apartment, thoughtfully designed for couples, friends, business travelers, and solo guests.

description:
Located on one of the most pleasant and quiet streets of the island, this charming house is ideal for those looking for a peaceful life. It offers a spacious living area where you can enjoy a barbecue on the balcony and relieve the tiredness of the day.
Our house, which is within walking distance to the beach, is 5 minutes from the ferry pier and 3 minutes from the motor pier.
Located on a quiet, beautiful and safe street, our house is an unmissable opportunity for those who want sea air, balcony enjoyment and island peace together.

reviews.text: Yusuf Bey’le çok sağlıklı iletişim kurabiliyorsunuz. Çözüm odaklı ve siz daha sormadan önerilerde bulunup problem çıkmasına bile mahal vermiyor. Ev fotoğraflarda gözükenin aynısıydı. Temizlik gayet yeterliydi. Evde sandığımızdan çok daha fazla mutfak araçları vardı. Arayıp bulamadığımız hiçbir şey olmadı. Balkonu çok keyifliydi. Konumu Heybeliada’da olabilecek en iyi konumdu. Limandan 5 dk yürüme diyebilirim. Heybeliada’da konaklamak isteyenler için ilk önereceğim yerlerden biri oldu. Her şey için teşekkür ederiz. 🤍

Artıları:
Konum merkeze aşırı yakın. İskeleden maksimum 5dk uzakta.
Temizlik gayet iyiydi. Herhangi bir sorunla karşılaşmadık. Yatak örtüleri ve havlular yeni yıkanmıştı.
Mutfak gayet kullanışlıydı. Bulaşık süngeri sıfır olarak konulmuştu.
İletişim olarak da ev sahibi tüm sorulara en hızlı şekilde dönüş yaptı. Hatta sorumuz olmasa bile bir ihtiyacımızın olmadığında emin oldu. Eve ilk girdiğimiz bize kahve ve tatlı da ikeam etti.
Soğuk havaya rağmen ev gayet sıcaktı.
Eksileri:
Aslında bu kısa süreli bir eksi olabilir. Evde karasinek problemi yaşadık. Havadan ve arka bahçedeki yavru kedilerden kaynaklanmış olabilir. Bir sonraki seferlerde bunun olmayacağını düşünüyoruz. Ev sahibine durumu söylediğimizde sinek ilacı dahil bir çok çözümü kapımıza kadar getirdi. Bu yüzden bu sıkıntıdan puan kırmadık.
Ev çok temiz,konumu harikaydı ve her şey düşündüğümüzden daha rahattı. Ev sahibide çok ilgiliydi. Çok keyifli bir konaklama geçirdik, en kısa sürede tekrar geleceğiz :)

her şey göründüğü gibiydi. banyo, tuvaletler, mutfak, yatak odası gayet temizdi. ihtiyacımız olan her şey mevcuttu. özellikle mutfakta araç gereç anlamında hiç sorun yaşamadık. Yusuf Bey her konuda gayet ılımlıydı iletişimde de sorun yaşamadık. lokasyon olarak iskeleye yürüme mesafesinde çok yakın. balkonu geniş ve ferah yaz aylarında gidildiğinde keyifli olacaktır :)

Yusuf Bey, girişten çıkışa kadar çok ilgili davrandı. İletişim konusunda hiçbir sorun yaşamadık.
Ev, tam olarak bilgilerde yazdığı ve fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. İçeri girdiğimizde tertemiz ve derli topluydu.
Evde hemen hemen ihtiyaç duyabileceğimiz tüm ürünler mevcuttu.
Mutfak, banyo ve yatak odalarının temizliği oldukça iyiydi. İçimiz rahat bir şekilde kullanabildik.
Keyifli bir tatil yapmak isteyenler için mükemmel bir ev. İçim rahat bir şekilde tavsiye ediyorum.

description: Located in one of Kadıköy's most vibrant areas, this elegant 2+1 apartment combines the energy of city life with comfort. With its two separate bedrooms, spacious living room, and delightful balcony, it is ideal for those who want to both relax and experience the city. 10 minutes on foot to the Kadıköy Ferry Terminal and the metro, and a short walk to Marmaray and the metrobus. A central location, understated elegance, and tranquility all in one.

reviews.text: İlker Bey son derece ilgiliydi. Büyük bir sorun yaşamadım ufak tefek şeylerde de dakikalar içinde iletişim hâlindeydi benimle. Ev temizlenmişti ayrıca evde ihtiyacınız olabilecek neredeyse her şey mevcut. Benim için tek negatifi karşımızda muhtemelen kentsel dönüşüm kapsamında yıkılan binanın gürültüsü oldu. Ben ayrılacağım vakit pek işi kalmamıştı yani yakın zamanda kiralamayı düşünen arkadaşlara bilgi olsun. Bu yorumu aylar sonra okuyorsanız zaten böyle bir sorun kalmamıştır. Klima vardı o açıdan çok rahat ettik ayrıca evin lokasyonu mükemmel. Metrobüs, marmaray, metro, vapur hatlarının tamamına yürüme mesafesinde 12-13 dk. ve çok işlek bir muhitte kalıyor. Güzel bir deneyimdi, teşekkürler.

İlk andan itibaren İlker beyin iletişimi hem çok hızlı hemde çok iyiydi. Ev de bizi rahat ettirmek için çok ilgiliydi ve bir konu olduğunda hızla cevap verdi ve yardımcı oldu. Ev görsellerde olduğu gibi gayet rahat ve imkanları iyi bir ev. Merkezi konumda, heryere ulaşılabilecek bir yerdeydi. Evin yeri çok keyifli ve gerek Kadıköy'de gerekse İstanbul'un diğer yerlerinde güzel bir tatil yapmak için çok uygun. İlker bey çok ilgili bir ev sahibi ve misafirlerini rahat ettirmek için elinden geleni yapıyor. İstanbul'da tekrar görüşmek üzere diyorum. İlgi ve nezaketiniz için teşekkür ederim.
Evin konumu çok iyiydi. Ancak ücretsiz otopark yok, her yer ücretli ve çok pahalı. Akşamları merkezi olmasından kaynaklı gürültü olabiliyor. Ev temizdi ancak eşyaları eskiydi. İletişimi iyiydi.
Ev gerçekten lokasyon olarak çok iyi aynı zamanda evdeki mobilyalar ve eşyalar da tertemiz ve çok kullanışlıydı. Tüm imkanlarına rağmen oldukça da ucuzdu kesinlikle tavsiye ederim
İlker beye nezaketi ve ilgisi için çok teşekkür ediyoruz. Ev görsellerde nasılsa öyleydi, hatta biz eve bayıldık 😊Konumu da harika. Şiddetle tavsiye ediyoruz😉

description:
A Comfortable Escape in the Heart of History

We are located in the heart of Old Istanbul, from Sultanahmet and Hagia Sophia (5 minutes), the Grand Bazaar (7 minutes walking). With easy access to public transportation, you can reach all parts of Istanbul.
Your comfortable room is entirely yours. Bathrooms, kitchens, and other are shared.

All your bathroom needs, including towels, shampoo, bathrobes, and disposable slippers, are provided by us.

reviews.text:
Social House is a great place to stay in Istanbul. The location is perfect — walking distance to Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, and the tram stop.
The host (Abdullah/Muhammed) was incredibly kind and accommodating. Even after checkout, they allowed me to store my luggage and use the facilities until late at night when I had to catch my overnight bus at 11PM. That kind of hospitality goes above and beyond!
The room was comfortable and clean, great value for the Sultanahmet area. Would definitely recommend for solo travelers exploring Istanbul.
Thank you Social House team! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

description:
This is a neighborhood where you can feel the most modern local spirit of Kadıköy. Come and experience the historic Yeldeğirmeni neighborhood :)

reviews.text:

The host was absolutely amazing: so kind, welcoming, and always willing to help whenever I needed anything. They also shared great recommendations that made my stay even better.
I truly appreciated the warmth and care they showed throughout my visit. I would happily stay here again and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable stay with a wonderful host.

The place was an excellent deal for its price. Located in a central spot in Kadikoy, nice and spacious, and had a fan for the hot summer.
Deniz was a real friendly guy and helped out with the minor issues I had.

reviews.text:

worst of all, no soundproofing between neighbour. The apartment is in an amazing location with tons of budget friendly restaurants nearby. The apartment was super clean and the outdoor terrace/patio was lovely. Having read previous reviews, I knew to expect the stairs as well as having to run the water for a bit in order to get the hot water going. That being said, Kürsad helped us carry our bags to the apartment and the rainfall shower head was superb. Overall, good value and great location!

I arrived late at night at this location and it was easy to find from the instructions. Unfortunately the kitchen had not been cleaned prior to arrival as there was still food/dishes in the sink. However the host was responsive, apologized, and issued refund immediately. Otherwise the amenities were as described including patio area and laundry which was great. Location very walkable to shops nearby.

Kürşad is a very Professional host with a keen eye for detail and was always very quick to respond. the apartment is exactly as advertised and very close to Istkalal Street and many nice things in walking distance. shower pressure is very good and cleanliness on par with expectations of any reputable major hotel brand.

The place looks the same as on photos. Very big terrace! There is enough space for 3 person in that apartment. It has 2 conditioners in bedroom and in the kitchen. Wifi connection was good most of the time. Bed was comfortable. The place is on the 4-th floor but no elevator. But you get a terrace for that fact and house master helped us to bring up our luggage, so I see no inconvenience on that point. The apartment is very close to Isiklal street, but here it is very quiet. Only accidental seagulls can wake you up in the early morning. Metro station is also very close. The laundry room is also available which was very useful. The owner of the place responded very quick to any of our needs. Totallly recommend for those who like to watch at Bosphorus in the morning and then have fun at Istiklal street in evening.

description:
FAMILY RUN BUSINESS – 24 HOURS RECEPTION (Less than 1 minute distance) – FREE MINI BREAKFAST (Less than 1 minute distance) – 3MINS TO ISTIKLAL STREET – MARKETS & PATISSERIES NEARBY – SAME FLAT IN THE PHOTOS – 10% DISCOUNT in OUR CAFE

How we fight against COVID-19: We do the cleanings with mask and gloves. Our cleaning process is in-line with local & global rules and guidelines. We also have our own laundry and wash all bedhseets and towes 60c hot.

reviews.text:
We stayed at Istanberry for a recent weekend in Istanbul, at the end of 10 days traveling around Turkey. The apartment was immaculately clean and looked just like the photos. The neighborhood is definitely "local" (not touristy). You can easily walk to the Istiklal Cd street which seems to buzz all day and night. The market across the street from the apartment is open 24 hours and is convenient for buying bottled water, etc.
We found the host to be very kind, responsive, and helpful when needed. For example, a hair dryer was missing from the apartment when we arrived and he immediately replaced it; he helped us with wifi issues and also organized a taxi to pick us up for an early flight on our departure.
The downside for us: for a weekend stay, we found the Istanberry location did not work well for us. We weren't familiar with the city and despite the distance estimates provided by the host, we mistakenly underestimated the time it would take us to walk to/from the main public transportation hubs. The location might be perfectly fine for someone living in Istanbul for a week or longer--again, you're well-connected to a popular shopping and nightlife area to explore and just "be." But, since we were only there for the weekend, we lost a lot of our brief time commuting.
Further, it was raining hard our entire weekend, so in a couple instances we would have preferred to take a taxi to stay dry. Our experience was that several taxi drivers either did not know the location or refused to take us to a nearby drop off point since that particular area was difficult for cars to get to. We live in a city ourselves and usually prefer to take public transportation or walk (vs take a taxi), whether at home or when traveling...but since it was raining that weekend in Istanbul and the walk to the tram/funicular stations was long enough to get very wet, this was inconvenient. In hindsight, for a weekend in Istanbul, we would have preferred closer proximity to a public transportation station with easy airport access, so as to have more time to enjoy the city itself. We'd also stay longer than just a weekend! :)

The Istanberry flats were exactly like in the pictures. Clean and bright. Our hosts were incredibly helpful and nice. Their office which is really 15 seconds away can deal with any request you might have as a tourist. The neigbourhood...is what one would describe as run down..but I would just describe it as "real". Real people, real markets, real shops, real everyday life. It was very central you can walk to Taxim and to the tunel and to the metro and to the Tram. The "run down neighbourhood", is only 2 blocks away from the very busy main shopping street of Istanbul Istaclal. So really it's just around the corner. The market on Sundays was an amazing experience (we were asked to share breakfast with the men in the market and welcomed to their make shift table) .I loved watching the "real" market people set up around 09.00 in the morning (so you won't be woken up), and it went on until 20.00. Then the take down, which was also very interesting to watch, ended at about 24.00 when the gypsy kids and finished gathering up the carrots and lettuce leaves and the street cleaners and finished cleaning up. They have a hair dryer, although it is not listed, they gave me an icepack for my sore back and an extra pillow when I asked for it. Istanbul is a noisy city , but this area was fine. You could also hear the Imam calling for prayer in the distance , which was nice but not ripping you out of your sleep. Their shower was amazing. really strong pressure and always hot water , which is important when you have been walking for 10 hours. I can only recommend it! Thank you very much!!

Shortly speaking, it is a perfect place to stay for a couple of weeks. I would certainly recommend it.
Pros:
Real 24/7 support, fast answers, responsiveness.
Free light breakfast every day, nice cafe nearby with affordable prices
Free luggage store
Free room cleaning every 4 days! Cleaning is good
If you need help - you will certainly get it. Luggage was brought to the room on arrival, also carried on departure. We were very pleased. When we needed taxi to the airport, they ordered it for us and trip price was not expensive.
Cons:
The only issue - problems with cold batteries (heating system). But when we asked, they have been fixed. I strongly believe that heating will be ok.
My recommendation!

I had a great experience at this Airbnb. The location, though close to the central street, requires a 15-minute uphill walk. The accommodation lacked proper sound insulation, and the absence of an elevator should be considered during check-in. Communication with the host was excellent, and the service was pristine. However, a sofa cleaning would enhance the overall cleanliness. Considering the price, it's a great value. The included breakfast was a delightful addition.

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Istanberry flats, and highly recommend it to any traveler! The apartment is spacious and clean, and recently renovated with all mod cons, flat screen T.V, WiFi, fridge, hairdryer etc. Felt like a hotel stay. Centrally located in the trendy Beyoğlu district, it is walking distance to great restaurants and bars near the medieval Galata, and the elegant shopping İstiklal Avenue, visited by nearly 3 million people a day! (Make sure to check out the views from hotel 360) Also walking distance to the touristy Taksim Square, where you can easily travel to the Sultanahmet area via tram. On Sunday you will be treated to an authentic Bazaar right from your doorstep. It can be noisy, so bring earplugs just in case. The host Guven was very welcoming and professional, great English skills. He accommodated my late check in, and organized a taxi to pick me up early to get back to the airport. Happy to recommend this place, and am very happy I chose this area over Sultanhmet. Much more authentic Istanbul experience.

description:
ELEVATOR (LIFT) – FAMILY RUN BUSINESS – 24 HOURS RECEPTION 3 MIN DISTANCE – FREE MINI BREAKFAST – EASY TO FIND – 3MINS TO ISTIKLAL STREET – NO CLEANING FEE – FREE LUGGAGE STORAGE – FREE BABY EQUIPMENTS – MARKETS & PATISSERIES NEARBY – ENTIRE APARTMENT (Not shared)

reviews.text:
The place is relatively close to Taksim and Port area, it is situated in a quiet neighborhood. If you are traveling on your own car, note, that narrow streets make it challenging to find a parking place.
During the stay we had no hot water for a day, which ruined some of our plans (it was fixed by the host the next day, but I have to note this situation).
Small local breakfast as a compliment was a nice touch (we tried it once).
Overall, we are satisfied with our stay at Güner-Berivan's apartment.

Everything was great, description and photos are real and you get what you paid for. Only downsides were hot water being not hot enough (luke-warm), refrigerator not working properly and overall neighborhood didn't feel safe. Overall it is very worth it, recommend it

I recently stayed at this apartment for five days and had a wonderful experience. The apartment was clean, modern, and well-maintained, making it feel like a home away from home. The living area was spacious, with comfortable furniture and plenty of natural light.
The location was perfect, situated in a quiet neighborhood but still close to public transportation and local attractions. It was easy to explore the city and return to a peaceful and relaxing environment.
The host was extremely accommodating and responsive, providing clear instructions for check-in and check-out, and offering helpful tips about the area. They made sure I had everything I needed and were always available to answer any questions.

Everything was great! The place was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The host was friendly, responsive, and made check-in super easy. I had a very comfortable stay and would definitely come back or recommend it to others. Thank you!

We were delighted with this apartment and the excellent service from the staff, who were always kind and ready to help with any questions. They assisted us with our luggage upon arrival and were attentive and friendly throughout our stay. The apartment was very clean and fully equipped for a comfortable visit.
We liked the area a lot. It is accessible, and although some reviews mentioned it felt "sketchy," we had no issues. We saw police regularly and felt safe. It is a local residential neighborhood that reflects traditional daily life.
The breakfast was a great bonus and they kindly adapted it to a vegan diet on request.
Another reason we chose this place was their support for stray cats and dogs, which we find especially important in a city like Istanbul. We appreciate that, and we wish more places would adopt similar initiatives. In their words: "By booking our apartments, you are also helping stray cats & dogs. We use 5% of our revenue to feed and aid them.
Highly recommended!

description: This is a 6 unit apartment. There are three 32 M2 and three 35 M2 units. All units have private bathroom and kitchen. Washing and drying machine is in the common area. Heating with natural gas. This is a silent street but also very central.

reviews.text:
Excellent location in a quiet area facing the sea. A small Carrefour and a Starbucks are nearby. Taksim Square is not far and can be accessed on foot or by taking the F1 from Kabataş. A T1 tram stop is right in front of the building and the tram can drop you directly at Sultanahmet.
Nice apartment with a spacious bedroom. The kitchen is well equipment and the washing machine in the bathroom is a plus.
Erdem is a very nice and helpful host. We ended up renting his second smaller apartment in the same building as well. Highly recommended.

Really nice, clean and well located flat. The host is really helpful and kind.
There is everything you need in the flat and if not you can ask to the host.
It’s look like on the pictures.
I definitely recommend this flat for short AND long stay !

Evren bey hızlı cevap verdi ve konum olarak güzel bir şekilde tarif verdi. Evin konumu gerçekten güzeldi, her yere yürüme mesafesinde ama biraz ara sokaktaydı. öncelikle konumu gerçekten iyiydi,esnek giriş çıkış saatleri sunuldu. bulunması kolaydı ve eşyalarımzı bırakma konusunda imkan verildi fakat hijyenik değildi çarşaflar değiştirilmemişti ve çöpler duruyordu. banyo zaten girilecek gibi değildi havluların da temiz olduğunu düşünmüyorum onun dışında dönütler çabuk sağlandı ve kolay iletişimde bulunduk

The transportation to the airport is also affordable and good service.
I will say the free breakfast they advertise is not worth it, if that's an interest point for you booking. It's barely any food, and the service is subpar.

My stay at this house was amazing because
1- the whole house was really clean
2-bed was comfortable
3-heating system worked well

Awesome place to stay at. The host is professional and friendly always willing to help. Stayed in 2 of their places, both high quality, clean, as described, breakfast included, close to the main street and overall Beyoglu is the best neighborhood to stay. Would recommend Istanberry to anyone who visits Istanbul.

So, the place is in a very convenient location. Very central, but still quiet. The car and people noise from the streets is very minimal which is a big plus and not at all a given in Istanbul. Very comfortable and high value for money.
HOWEVER, I'll have to say that the vintage approach of the shower with the cursed UK style faucets is always a definitely minus for practicality, although a small one. Additionally, the shower works somewhat randomly. They're very attentive to any problems, and reachable at a moment's notice via WhatsApp or other means. If you're willing to overlook some possible minor problems (and perhaps if the shower does not work properly, try again in an hour...) you should have no problems here!

description:
✨ Welcome to Nişantaşı Life Residence Apartments ✨
A brand-new, earthquake-resistant building with 24/7 security and CCTV surveillance for complete comfort and safety.
Spacious, elegant apartments fully air-conditioned, with a modern elevator.
📍 Prime location in the heart of Nişantaşı, just steps away from restaurants, shopping centers, and public transport.

The perfect choice for families and guests seeking comfort and luxury in Istanbul.

reviews.text:
As I'll be visiting Istanbul for five days two times a month in the next couple of months, finding a place that could suit all my needs, combined with location and budget might not be that easy actually.
We are travelling two using the option with separate bedrooms. New furnitures, comfy beds. Enough space, living room, kitchen, big bathroom. Very easy self check in / check out (I value that alot!).
Will great pleasure I already booked for my second stay there.

The apartment was surprisingly quiet for such a centralized location. We loved the location, lots to d and close to the Osmanbey metro station that gives you access to much of the city. The neighborhood was safe, we never felt unsafe walking home at all times of the day. The apartment was clean and i appreciate the clean white linens. The slight issue was the wifi and could be attributed to the area. The apartment itself was functional and had everything we needed. We were comfortable throughout our stay.

The apartment was good overall, but there were a couple of issues that affected our stay. The bathroom had poor drainage, so the floor was always wet after using the shower. In addition, there was no parking available, and I had to pay an extra $100 for parking during our 5-night stay. I hope these issues will be addressed, as they would make the apartment much more comfortable for future guests.

The place Is ok
The personal of the building very kind and they help us a lot. I’m grateful with them, But honestly for the price I been in Istanbul in better apartments with better location.
Konum olarak ideal, Ev Sahibi’nin sorunlara yanıt süresi iyiydi. İlgili ve cana yakın ev sahipliği için teşekkür ederiz.

description: Experience Istanbul from your own private rooftop penthouse in the heart of Galata. Enjoy breathtaking Bosphorus, Galata Tower and Historic Peninsula views from your exclusive private rooftop terrace. Just steps from Galata Tower, Galataport, Karaköy, Istiklal Street, metro, tram and ferries. Perfect for families, friends and remote workers seeking comfort, privacy and one of Istanbul's most unforgettable views.

reviews.text:
Çınar’s place is the Galata area, very convenient for visiting Istanbul. We loved the location. When we arrived, we ran into the host at the entrance and he ended up checking us in personally. He was very friendly and welcoming.
The place is like the photos and large for 2 of us. It was clean and comfortable. The view from the roof top terrace is excellent. While it is near the Galata tower, it is quite quiet, while there are a lot of restaurants and shops within minutes of walking. I think it is a very good place to stay when visiting Istanbul, highly recommended.
Be prepared to walk uphill and walk up the stairs. There can be a lot in the area and the apartment is on the top floors too. However, it is worth it.

We stayed in Cinar's apartment for 8 nights in March, let me start with the positive things :

- Cinar was very helpful and responsive
- Location was great, very close to Galata tower, restaurants, bars etc.
And this is what we did not like..
- The apartment is smaller and older than what it looks like in the pictures
- The balcony is narrow, the terrace small and difficult to reach with a ladder. Also the balcony doors are difficult to open and close
- One of the beds was missing
- The cleanliness o the place was approximative, we found dust and hair when moving things around, the vacuum cleaner was also dirty so that we could not properly clean ourselves
-Twice the wifi did not work for a few hours
Overall it was not great, and for the price we paid, we could have probably found something better.

The hosts are very welcoming, it was nice to meet them. They helped us to bring our luggage up to the apartment. We were allowed to check-in earlier. Two big bottles of pretty good water were provided for us - thanks for that!
Unfortunately the apartment doesn't match the description. Places for sleeping differ in count and location. Everything is pretty old and has significant marks of usage. Many things are broken or partially broken (don't see how I can attach the photos here). We had issues with closing one of the windows. Wi-Fi connection is pretty bad, we spent some time trying to make it working. Hot water in the shower is very limited. I would say that the apartment fits max 4 people. Also it's worth to note that there is no elevator and the stairs is pretty narrow.

Don’t forget there’s an uphill walk to Galata Tower, but it’s very easy to reach Karaköy by going down a short staircase nearby — super convenient! The only downside is that there’s no elevator, and the apartment is on the top floor, so carrying luggage can be a bit hard. Just a small suggestion — adding a kitchen cleaning cloth, some paper towels, and a mop would be helpful. The terrace table wasn’t clean, but everything else was great. Having AC in every room and balconies opening from each one was fantastic. Thanks to the privacy film on the windows, you can keep the curtains open without being seen from outside.
The rooftop terrace inside the apartment has a breathtaking view — Galata Tower behind you, the Bosphorus and historic peninsula in front. The bed was large and comfy, and finding cold water in the fridge after a late-night arrival was a lovely touch. Çınar was super helpful and responsive. Highly recommend!✨

Çınar is absolutely the best Airbnb host I've ever met! This is the second place of his I stayed, and it was just as wonderful. This gorgeous flat is just like the photos. Bright, spacious, feels luxurious, and cozy even in winter. With heaters on it was perfectly warm even when snowing! Comfortable beds, sparkling clean rooms, warm water, and all the needed facilities for cooking, dining, storage, and even working remotely. The view from the rooftop is also breathtaking - I spent some sunny days with a book up there! And the location is perfect, near a small shop for essentials, near fabulous shops (check Galata Leather!), restaurants, coffee shops, and of course so close to Galata tower and the Galata bridge. Also, if you want food delivery the location is easy for this too! :) If you need anything at anytime, Çınar responds instantly and does everything he can to help. For example, there was a small electric break (city power issue) and within 30 minutes the electrician came and everything was fixed and perfectly normal - amazing. He also loaned me an umbrella because I didn't have one. He insisted I keep it for my travels but it's still available for the next lucky guest! Thank you for everything, Çınar!

description:
Spacious, clean and cosy flat located in a safe decent neighborhood in the heart of Sile.

Ideal both leisure and business travelers.

Large balconies let you enjoy beautiful sea view, sunset, constantly dancing colors of sea and sky.

Despite the place is located at the Sile center it is far away from the crowd and noise of town.

reviews.text: Cemre was super helpful with us and helped us with checking in despite our late reservation and changed her schedule accordingly. She was very quick in communication and responded helpfully to our inquiries. The apartment is on a great location in Sile with an amazing sea view with two balconies. It is nicely decorated in a cozy way and it was super clean and tidy, we felt comfortable like home! The apartment in general, and kitchen have all the essentials (and even more) for a nice stay and we enjoyed watching Netflix on her TV and account. The heating system is adjustable and enough even for cold days. This was an excellent stay for us and with this reasonable price, we definitely recommend it.

Cemre is an incredibly good host. She was supportive, and responded quickly to messages. The flat is comfortable, with everything you need available.
Our only discomfort was how loud the neighbourhood was. We could hear neighbours speaking loudly and even shouting after midnight, and in the morning a construction began right next door which was also very loud.
It is important to know that you have to climb a significant hill to get to the flat. If you have accessibility issues, it will be challenging. There is also no elevator in the apartment building.
However, all in all, it was a good place to stay for our vacation in Sile, at a short walking distance to shops, restaurants, and the beach.

Superb experience!! The host was extremely supportive and always going the extra mile, waking up in the middle of the night to make the key handover happen. Very clean house, great location, top value for money. Nice decorations and equipment inside the house. All taken care of. We look forward to coming back at the next opportunity.

Cemre Hanım harika bir insan. İletişimi çok kuvvetli ve cana yakın birisi. Bize esnek çıkış imkanı sundu ve arabasıyla terminale kadar bıraktı. Hatta biz otobüse binene kadar bizi bekledi :) Yaptığımız en iyi Airbnb deneyimiydi. Ev de çok temizdi gönül rahatlığıyla konaklayabilirsiniz.

Cemre is very good host she helped us all the time with everything we needed up to ordered us a taxi to the airport . Her home is very cleaned pleasant with good energy. The location is also very convenient to the small but charming downtown and sea. Supermarkets are also closed. The view from the balcony is something exciting. I definitely recommend for vacation if you are looking calm relaxing stay

description:
Welcome to your home away from home in Samatya!

This fully furnished 2+1 apartment is conveniently located within walking distance of the Education and Research Hospital. Perfect for professionals, visiting doctors, or anyone seeking a clean, comfortable long-term stay.

Apartment Highlights:

Fully equipped kitchen with modern appliances

Comfortable living and dining area

Clean bedrooms with fresh linens

Fast Wi-Fi and utilities included

Balcony with natural light and sea views

reviews.text: As you may know as a traveller, upon arrival to your destination, the first thing you would like to do when you arrive to your destination is eat, take a nice shower and freshen up. However, upon arrival, I was disgusted to find that there was pee and a clump of hair left in the toilet. When I tried to flush it, the toilet did not work. I proceeded to attempt to have a shower and no water came out of the faucet. I was so upset that the shower did not work considering I paid a cleaning fee for this stay. The place was not thoroughly cleaned either. I contacted the owner Onur to resolve the issue but I had to wait for over 24 hours for the plumber to come in to fix the toilet and the shower. To make matters worse, they had a major ant infestation issue in the kitchen and living room area. Although the view was beautiful it was not even worth it since the place was extremely noisy due to the traffic from the highway and street facing the apartment as well as the rowdy people hanging outside. The weak windows are located both in the living/kitchen room area and bedroom so the noise level reminds me of New York City in Istanbul. You will definitely need headphones to get to sleep! The location was good for convenience to be around markets and restaurants though. The stairs was brutal if you have a lot of luggage. If you have a light carry on and a back pack you will be fine. However, if you have more than that you better be careful because there is no elevator only steep and narrow stairs with no railing which can be quite dangerous especially if you are a senior, have a disability or a solo traveller whose a woman trying to carry heavy luggage all by herself. I was really turned off by the owner Onur and his brother Muhammad (who I dealt with via phone conversations most of the time since he claimed that his brother is not in the country) rude, disrespectful, passive aggressive behaviour towards me even though I was very professional and respectful to them despite my bad experience. In addition, I kindly requested a refund as well as the cleaning fee back considering the fact I had to clean the apartment myself. Onur agreed to give me the refund due to the inconvenience I had with the maintenance and cleaning issues with the place however, when I reminded him I needed the refund issued to me immediately he lied and retracted his agreement with me regarding providing me with a refund and then had the nerve to tell me if I left now (time was 1 am on that day) maybe he would refund me the cleaning fee. Since he did not give me a refund, I had no choice to stick it out since it was a very expensive 1 week stay. My interactions with Onur and his brother gave me a bad taste of Istanbul. They both were really dishonest, arrogant, inconsiderate, money hungry people. Don’t even bother with this place. Look for a better option and save yourself the hassle and horrible experience!

House: better than it looks in the photos. Amazing view of Marmara sea from the house, fully functional kitchen with every small thing taken care of. Same goes for rest of the amenities where Onur has kept in mind every thing a person might need.
Host: Onur was always easy to contact. He suggested a number of really nice places in the city and helped us with settling down on our 9 day trip.
Neighborhood: An easy to find place, not too far from public transportation. Basic grocery shops, daily food joints and Buses are available right below the house. Metro is merely 5 minutes away. The places has easy access to sultanahmet and grand bazaar area.

wonderful apartment, clean, beautiful and comfortable, with all the necessary items. Mehmet (the host) is very helpful and friendly. first time stayed here for the New Year holidays, I liked everything very much. The location is great, a little out of the center, but generally close to everything and most importantly the amazing view on the Marble Sea. The bedroom is comfortable and silent, we slept great. we will be happy to come back to you again! Thank you very much for a nice stay!

Onur is an excellent host,very fast in responses,kind and helpful.His apartament is in the center of the city,with plenty of shops and restaurants in the neighborhood.It is not a touristic area,but is authentic with really nice people living there.Apartament itself is very comfortable with an amazing see view.It is a very clean and spacious place,where I felt immediately at home.It is so easy to explore the city from this spotThe bus stop is 100 meters away and takes you directly to Taxim sqare.Another bus can take you to Sultanahmet area,where most of the holistorical sites are.If you are a light sleeper,then maybe in summertime with open windows,the noise from the traffic can disturb you but other than that this is an incredible place to stay while in Istanbul!

Onur place was great, we felt we were at home, the area is a bit noisy from the highway side, but the view is worth it.
Also the neighborhood is safe, the guy at the shop across the street was very kind and helpful, easy access to taxi and public transportation, 5 min to yenikapi metro station. You have shops, small authentic restaurants.
Onur is very responsive and helpful, me made serious efforts to replace the internet modem and now the flat has very high speed internet.

description: Stay in the heart of Beyoğlu, just steps from Istiklal Avenue, Galata Tower, and Pera Museum. Enjoy a stylish, well-appointed room with plush bedding, air conditioning, floor heating, and a modern en-suite bathroom. Perfect for sightseers, digital nomads, and business travelers, our location offers easy access to top attractions, dining, and nightlife. Experience comfort and convenience in vibrant Istanbul!

reviews.text:
Everything was exactly like in the pictures. The bed very comfortable, the heating floor was a cool asset of the room.
Our host Mustafa and his colleagues were very friendly and helpful.
The location of the place is amaizing, accessible by walking to all the nice places around.
Overall was a great staying. Highly recommended!

A very clean, neat and tidy hotel room! It's exactly as the pictures show it to be. A couple of minutes walk from Istiklal Street. Hotel is located on a smaller street so it's really quiet, unlike most other hotels in Taksim.
Mustafa was an amazing host. He arranged transport to and from the airport. He also scheduled our Covid tests, which were done at the hotel itself. We didn't have to worry about any of that stuff and were able to focus on enjoying our trip!
All in all, an excellent place to stay!

The only thing that could be better is the Shower cabin, although it was very clean inside, the Doors had some mold stains on the rails.
Apart from that Detail, we got greeted by Sophia, who was extremely friendly and helpful. He showed us our room and was asking us daily If we needed anything. A daily cleaning Service could be used by just pressing a button on their Apartment system.
Not only would I recommend the place, I would also rebook it on my next visit.
All in all, great Location, great Hosts, very nice price-quality Ratio.

Mustafa is one of the most amazing hosts I ve ever met, he’s very nice and helpful. I booked for my parents at Mustafa’s hotel and he took a really good care of them. The place was clean and cosy, the location perfect and the room looked exactly like the pictures. Definitely recommend it. Thank for everything my friend see you soon.

Mustafa and Paulina were excellent hosts!! Made us feel right at home, provided us with information about local transportation, attractions, and food recommendations. Also ordered us a taxi back to the airport for a great price, better than Uber and local taxi service. Room was clean and fresh, washroom was modern and spotless. Water bottles, coffee, towels, soap, shampoo complimentary. Fresh linens. Next time I’ll be sure to contact Mustafa directly instead of using the app. These guys deserve your business!!! Less than 5 min walk to TAKSIM Square!!

description:
Your cozy home is located in Istanbul, Taxim area @Beyoglu. It's about 200 meter away from the British Consulate and the world famous Istiklal Street which is no doubt the most colorful place with cafes, bars, shopping, art galleries, nightlife etc.
There is no extra cleaning after checkin, but we can consider cleaning when you request.

reviews.text: We stayed at Verda's apartment for three nights in the middle of October. The place was very clean and had everything we needed, including free wi-fi. The apartment's location was great - a few minutes away from Istiklal Street and there was also a very cheap parking nearby for our car. The host was very responsive. We had a very pleasant stay and would gladly recommend the place.

Pros:
- Verda is a great host, always responsive and friendly. Stayed professional and always wanted to help.
- Great location near Taksim, so its easy to quickly get to restaurants etc.
- Cheap price, compared to some other places in the area.
- Nice living room space
Cons:
- Wifi only works in living room
- Bathroom is very small
- The property is in dire need of maintenance, I booked for 2 weeks, but moved out after 1 night. (Sockets off wall, gas keeps ticking, damp on ceiling etc).
Overall, you get what you pay for, if you don’t care about the apartment and just want a place to sleep, this is the perfect place for you. If you’re like me and need a clean and cosy environment to come home to after a long day, I’d recommend looking elsewhere.

We had a most wonderful time in this apartment. Verda and Halis made us feel so welcome. The apartment is extremely comfortable, great bed, kitchen and bathroom as well as wifi. The couch in the living room becomes a bed too. It is located in a very convenient area, very close to Isklatal street in Istanbul and yet just far enough away that we were in a very local Turkish neighbourhood. So we enjoyed shopping at the local bakery, grocery shop and greengrocer just up the street from an old Armenian Church. We woke every morning to the sound of the muezzin from the mosque a block away. It's easy walking distance to 2 metro stops and the Tunel (funicular down to Galata bridge). Halis was there to meet us and immediately took us on a short tour, pointing out several great(well within our budget) restaurants where could eat (our lack of Turkish not a hinderance to the staff there who were so friendly; we went to them many times!) Verda was so generous and helpful, providing us with extra kitchenware and towels to accommodate our cooking needs and our visitors and providing much needed translation for us, as well as delicious homemade jams. We stayed for a month; this was the perfect flat and we are looking forward to returning to Istanbul!

The place was great, and really easy to get to anywhere from that location — between Galata Tower and Taksim, but off Istiklal, so not too loud at night. There’s a bunch of restaurants and little shops just up the street towards Istiklal, and it’s easy to get trapped there, sipping coffee, and forgetting to go see the sights. It’s also an easy walk to Tunel, take the tram down to Karikoy, and getting to museums or ferries is easy from there. In the other direction is Taksim, and public transit to everywhere that isn’t Karakoy, including the funicular to the Kabatas ferries. All in all, a pretty great location. It’s not a slick neighborhood, but the neighbors are genuinely friendly folk, the kind of spot where everyone looks after each other and kids run around in the street a lot.

It’s very close to the Dervish House Museum as well, which didn’t seem as well trafficked as many of the others, but was great. It’s also part of the MuseumKart deal, which is absolutely worth doing. There’s also a major Sunday market across from the end of the street, with amazing food, spices, clothes, etc. It’s not a tourist thing, most of the people shopping there are locals.

The place is very new. It’s a good private nook. There’s a balcony, but it’s easy to lock out the sights and sounds of the city, put on the AC, and have lunch or read a book. We ran into a couple glitches with appliances, but Verda and her husband were by very quickly to sort things out. One warning: if you’re not comfortable with stairs, it’s not a great location, they are a fairly narrow spiral.

All in all, Verda went out of her way to make sure our stay was comfortable and untroubled — on down to insisting I needed to leave 30 minutes earlier than I’d planned on the Havitas if I wanted to make my flight on time. She was right, of course.

The host is very welcoming and responsive. She answers to the messages pretty fast. The house was clean and well kept. The location is close to Istiklal street which is the central part of the city. The building itself however is rather old and and there is no lift.

description:
Discover the perfect blend of convenience and comfort at our centrally located flat. With just a few steps to the famous Istiklal Caddesi (Taksim street) and a short 10-minute walk to Taksim Square, you'll find yourself at the heart of Istanbul's vibrant atmosphere. The strategic location ensures easy access to all public transportation options, making it a breeze to explore the city's attractions.
We look forward to hosting you and providing a delightful experience in the heart of Istanbul!

reviews.text: Excellent location, clean and comfortable apartment that is attached to a hotel. It is located right at the doorstep of Istiklal street. The staff were excellent and very supportive. There was some AC trouble with the apartment that was taking a bit long to fix and the staff allocated us two amazing rooms in the hotel. The staff was excellent, great communication and arranged SIM cards and pick up from the airport. Strongly recommend this.

Mehmet was an amazing host. He was always responsive, quick and helpful. The apartment was clean and just as described. Location is so perfect that you have a variety of restaurants and eateries just a stones throw away. The popular Istiklal Street is just a minute from here. The housekeeping lady named Gülehan has been very sweet and helpful. Also thankful to front desk people Sonuglu and Emir for being hospitable at all times. Overall we had a wonderful stay, if I am ever back to Istanbul I would prefer staying here only. Thank you Mehmet!

If I be allowed to give 10 stars I would not hesitate to give 10 stars. Super nice host. Excellent and professional staff speaking good English and always helpful. Esp Ms Songul Olcay and the gentleman on morning shift unfortunately I didn’t get to say thank you to him personally when I checked out I guess he was off duty. Super well located. Yes there are two short stairs but you can avoid walking one by entering from back door. Literally one min walk from İstiklal Caddesi. Well functioned washing machine and aircon (very important during summer) comfortable bed. Great rooftop restaurant view of entire Istanbul along with free breakfast. I may soon run out of characters but really everything has been great. I sound like I got paid to write this but I genuinely felt most grateful to the host and can totally write a thesis about how great they are. Definitely definitely would come back if I visit Istanbul again.

Absolutely loved our stay here. The hotel staffs service was amazing. Great breakfast with a beautiful view of the city from the roof top, the apartment itself was aesthetically pleasing, cosy and comfortable, we had an issue with the hot water not working but this was resolved very quickly, we had everything we needed in the apartment. One of the best things about this place was the location and never had an issue getting to places from there. Very lively place. I would definitely come back and stay at Mehmets place if I ever visited Istanbul again, highly recommended. I read some reviews about noise but to be honest the sounds in the streets or music isn't that loud that it would disturb or bother you. I'm very happy with everything this place had to offer in a great value for money. :) Thank you Mehmet.

We enjoyed our stay in the apartment. Included breakfast in the hotel with a greatview and comfortable beds. Unfortunately not super clean but OK. Internet connection was not the best. Location of the apartment was great and also the bathroom really mice and clean. Restaurant right in front of the exit is great! Thanks :)

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
A great and kind host with a lovely flat!
Felt very comfortable here, kitchen was stocked well, bed was comfortable and there was fast Wi-Fi with a working space that made the flat feel like home :)
Location is very near to plazas and malls and at a very central location. I found home very clean and comfortable. Definitely a budget/performance accommodation

I greatly enjoyed my week-and-a-half stay at this Airbnb with my cat.
Bilal, the host, was extremely friendly and offered significant assistance, even helping me carry my bags up to the third floor. He also provided help for managing my excess belongings before I moved out of Istanbul.
The place was clean and equipped with everything necessary for comfortable living. Plus, the view from the balcony is really good and calming.

Such a nice host and very cute apartment for price/performance. It had everything i needed, walking distance to metro and malls and also has a very nice balcony to hang out which is looking directly to the forest. Recommended 👍

Ev özellikle konum ve temizlik açısından çok iyiydi ve resimlerdeki gibi güzel bir yer.2 gece konakladım ve çok memnun kaldım.Bilal bey de ilgili ve yardımsever bir ev sahibiydi ve kendisine ne zaman ulaşmak istediysem hızlıca iletişim kurabildik

description: Enjoy your next stay in Istanbul in this new completely refurbished modern flat in the heart of the city. The flat comes with all amenities including Nespresso coffee machine and sound dock Beats by Dr. Dre, as well as tastefully chosen interior furniture and comfy bedding. Receives plenty of light as it is on a corner.

reviews.text:
Here are our pros and cons after staying for 1 month.
Pros:
Easy check-in, great for long stays had all the amenities you'll need(iron, vacuum, washing machine, plenty of towels and blankets, kitchen essentials), nice location with many restaurants nearby. Close to the metro and tram lines, Cristina was very responsive and helpful, we loved the interior design, it was enjoyable to stay in and comfortable and was accurate to the pictures. The shower was amazing with great water pressure. Nice internet, we didn't have any problems. Netflix on the TV was great.
Cons:
Don't be too surprised to see some small cockroaches especially at night. The plumbing isn't the best, toilet paper was required to go in the bin. There was a plumbing issue that happened under the sink and water was everywhere (Cristina was quick to respond and it was fixed promptly the next morning). There were a few times we were asked to leave the apartment for some hours which could be inconvenient for some people. The location is on a steep hill but that isn't out of the ordinary for Istanbul but it could be challenging for some. We were surprised when we were told about a weekly cleaning fee for 400 lira (around 20 USD) where we would be asked to leave for around 3 hours each time while someone would come and clean. (We payed for it once because it felt mandatory but after that first time we communicated that it wasn't necessary for us and it wasn't an issue after that)
All in all it was really a great and comfortable experience and we loved our month in Istanbul here. Would recommend this airbnb for a couple and for long stays.

Pros
The apartment was neat and clean as described.
The check-in was smooth.
The location is at walking distance from Taksim Square.
Host was responsive and supportive.
Cons
Steep walk to reach Taksim Square. Elder people may find it hard.
The hall AC wasn’t working when we arrived. Could not be fixed during our stay. Though the host was very supportive and arranged portable water cooler. However all utilities appliances should be checked before guest arrival.
I saw few cockroaches 🪳 roaming around :(
The host reimbursed 1 Night stay rent because of the inconvenience. That was very nice of her.

Cristina's apartment looks exactly how the photos show it. It is furnished with immaculate taste and quality items, and it is perfectly clean and in excellent condition. It is equipped perfectly with everything you may need even for a week or even longer stay. It is perfect value for its offered price!
Only downside is that there is a pretty steep slope you need to walk upwards to reach Taksim square so keep it in mind when choosing it - not for elderly! But if you walk downwards on a much comfortable slope, the sea shore with a tram line can be reached easily in a few minutes.
Also do not be surprised that the neighbourhood is pretty modest compared to the streets on the other side of Taksim square. But it is friendly, filled with lot of little grocery shops that are open during late night too which is a big plus. Overall it is a great place close to Taksim for its price , we were absolutely satisfied with what we got for our money.

Cristina’s place was brilliant. Very clean and stylish just like in the photos. Location was perfect, close to everything but in a quiet and very safe street. All in all it was a great stay, welcome fruit plate was a nice touch! Would definitely stay here again and would highly recommend!

it wasv a very good stay in this apartmentclean ,safe,quiet, comfortable bed .netflix. wifi. hot water . 8 min from taksim uphill and 8 min to kabatas pier downhill.
the host was responsive and helpful. I recommend.
