reviews.text: The apartment was very nice, with its arrangement, cleanliness and location. The owner of the apartment, Fatima, is very friendly and humble.

Everything was perfect. Fatima nice girl.
In this apartment you feel like at home. So comfortable. I love it.
Nice and clean. Clear instructions for entry.

As our first time being in turkey.
We were lucky and grateful enough to find Fatima.
It feels like home.
If you are looking for a home feeling in turkey. This is the place to be.
It was such a great experience.
Looking forward to book Fatima’s place for the next trip to turkey.
Best host ever !
Very nice house owner. Communication was very good and she fix problems quickly.

description: Welcome to our townhouse in the heart of Istanbul’s historic district. The property offers 5 bedrooms (3 double and 2 single beds) 3 bathrooms – perfect for families or groups. The most famous landmarks, such as Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar, Blue Mosque, and Bosphorus cruises, are all within walking distance. Cozy cafés & restaurants are right in the area. And there’s a kiosk next door. Fast Wi-Fi + A/C included.

reviews.text: The house was as described, clean, and a good value. There were some weird things that happened during our stay but Esra always responded quickly and was very helpful including local recommendations. We ended up staying later than checkout because the van we hired never arrived but Esra stepped up and arranged a transfer for us in only a few minutes. She was a pleasure to deal with. Would definitely recommend and I would stay there again.
The house was comfortable, clean and had a great location. Esra is also a friendly and helpful host. I would highly recommend this house :)

A great base from which to explore Istanbul. Comfortable for 6 people. Very steep stairs to lower bedroom. Walking distance to Old Town attractions and good access to public transport. Lots of restaurants and convenience stores nearby.

This was a great location to base ourselves for our trip to Istanbul. It was within walking distance to restaurants, local transit, and easily walkable to Sultanahmet Square.
Esra was very responsive and proactive, helping us book an airport shuttle and addressing questions as needed. The house itself was clean, spacious, and upgraded.
If you’re travelling with family or a group, this listing will provide you with ample space and convenience.
Great house in the old city. It’s new, clean, and great for groups and families. Walking distance to major attractions and there are plenty of restaurants around. Host was very responsive.

description:
Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.
Rental apartment in Sisli 3+1
above entrance

reviews.text: My group of 6 was very happy with our stay. It is clean and comfortable, seems newly remodeled, and the location was convenient right near our events. It is also near some good restaurants. You can walk a bit to get to Taksim Square or Osmanbey metro stations. Note that there are three bedrooms, with two single beds and one double bed.

Do you know what the word “Perfect” means? It means that everything is great! As great as our staying in this beautiful apartment. The host is great, the cleaning is great, the furniture is great and comfortable. Everything is new and cosy. We were warmly welcomed and felt like home.

Staying at this Airbnb in Istanbul was an absolute delight! The cozy yet stylish apartment provided everything we needed for a comfortable stay, and the location was unbeatable, with easy access to all the city's attractions. The host was incredibly welcoming and provided excellent recommendations for local eateries and sights to explore. We couldn't have asked for a better experience. Highly recommend!

Dies war meine erste Erfahrung mit Airbnb. Ich war besorgt, dass das Haus nicht wie auf den Fotos aussieht, aber beim Check-in war alles fantastisch. Das Haus war groß und perfekt für uns sechs Personen. Sauberkeit, Internet, warmes Wasser, Heizung und Klimaanlage waren erstklassig. Bei Fragen genügte eine Nachricht an das Coskun-Team, und sie antworteten schnell und lösten alle Probleme sofort.
Die Lage des Hauses war großartig: eine Bushaltestelle an der Straßenecke, zwei große Supermärkte in der Nähe und nur zehn Minuten zu Fuß zum Taksim-Platz. Mehrere Einkaufszentren waren leicht erreichbar. Wir hatten Zugang zu allem, was wir brauchten. Check-in und Check-out verliefen pünktlich und reibungslos, auch wenn wir etwas später ankamen.
Der Transport war ebenfalls hervorragend: Das Auto kam pünktlich und brachte uns ohne Stress zum Flughafen. Dies war meine Erfahrung mit diesem Haus und Gastgeber. Nochmals vielen Dank an Coskun und Mustafa für die wunderbare Zeit.
in general it was ok but there was electricity problem 3 times tha made it hard, the host was very helpfull and nice

description:
The flat is just next to Galata Tower.

Beyoğlu region and Galata was rebuilt after a big fire in 1870. We would define this date as the rebirth of Beyoğlu and say that many important historical buildings in Beyoğlu emerged after this date. The building was completed in the late 1800s in a European style. You will feel 150 years of history at the Galata, the foot of the tower.

reviews.text:
In case you would like to stay in untidy surrondings (streets full of garbage) in the middle of shops selling electrical goods and accesories, construction works - this is a place for you.
In short - the place for us (basically a travelling family) was a dissappointment. The hosts were not providing advise wished for (e.g practical travel tips for getting from airport to the appartment - we discovered ourselves a comfortable new metro line) and were not responsive on the remarks made during stay on cleaniness and comfortable bed linens. Bathroom was in need of clean carpet and shower was leaking. Pillows uncomfortable. Building entrance felt unsafe. The rooms were smaller than seen from the pictures and could have needed some renewal.
From the positive side - the view from the rooftop terrace was beautiful. And there is a grate jazz club Nardis in the neighbourhood.
Unfortunately this was our experience - it is the first time for me over years to write a negative feedback.

This apartment was very clean, and we really liked that the two bedrooms were at opposite ends of the hallway. It also had a nice patio off the kitchen. The bedroom closer to the door did have some street noise, but the other one was pretty quiet. We only went up to the rooftop once, since the stairs are kind of steep for folks in their 60s, but it did have a wonderful view.
Although the location is well situated for walking around New Town (right next to the Galata Tower), the street itself has a lot of electric supply houses that unload trucks throughout the day, which can cause traffic to backup. Keep this in mind if waiting for a taxi pickup.
The host helped us out by arranging for transportation to and from the airport, which reduced some of the stress of catching a cab.

Nice apartement, very well located in Istanbul, the roof terrace is a great spot, the apartment itself has a nice view. The apartment was clean and easy to live. The host was great, helpful and responsive. The apartment is on the fourth floor, with no lift, so it would not easily accomodate an old person. One of the bedrooms is in an open space along the main corridor. This is the one I took as I wake up early.

Merve was a great host! Though she do not speak English the communication via Airbnb messages was great and helpful. She always responded within minutes to all are questions and helped us with the cabs from and to the airport. The apartment fits the description and was very clean. The location was perfect very close to main sights by foot. The only downsize was the wifi connection which did not really worked outside the entry bedroom but nothing annoying. I definitely Recommend!

We had a wonderful experience in the apartment. It was exactly what we were looking for; 2 bedrooms with quality beds, a good shower and a great location. The view from the rooftop is fabulous. The only thing is that the windows do not really block the sound coming from the street but that's a minor detail as it is a relatively silent street at night. Ahmet was very responsive and friendly so I recommend staying here!

description: Enjoy this cosy apt in the historical peninsula of Istanbul. One of the best neighborhoods to experience the history and culture. Apt is in walking distance to coast. Surrounded with the main historical treasures, mosques, cultural restaurants and more. Also close to (10 min ride with taxi or bus) to Beyoğlu, Taksim square, Cihangir for entertainment and shopping. Great location to experience city culture with all aspects. You will find a smart guide at home that gives you tips around the city ✌️

reviews.text:
We greatly enjoyed our stay at Ceylan’s AirBnb property in the Sultanahmet district. The apartment was spotless, airy, well-lit, and with cute décor touches. The bathroom was very clean and recently renovated with a spacious shower and upgraded European style fixtures. A small kitchenette had all the basic utensils and amenities for light meal prep. Ceylan arranged to meet us at the property, and when we were delayed arriving, called and made sure we had all the relevant information for accessing wifi and the utilities before arriving.
She also warned us that street parking is tricky since this is the old part of town, but Ceylan had saved us a parking spot directly in front of the apartment and had provided us with nearby parking garages as alternatives. Be aware that streets in the area are narrow and the one leading to this AirBnb allows cars in only one direction at a time.
Ceylan and her family went above and beyond in making sure our stay was smooth and easy. We had an incident during our stay in Istanbul that necessitated us going to the ER at 11 pm at night, and Ceylan drove over and stayed at the hospital with us most of the night, translating for us with the doctors and arranging things so that we had everything we needed. The property managers, Eleni and Ahmet and their daughters, live above the property and were incredibly helpful, bringing us food, parking our car, checking in on us upon our return from the hospital, and arranging transportation to and from the hospital and then to the airport when it was time for us to leave.
Ceylan was amazing and we highly recommend a stay here at this beautiful property!

The accommodation is excellent, just like in the pictures, perfect for three people. It's extremely clean. It's located close to the tram, bus station, and ferry terminal. A great location for getting around Istanbul in all directions. Ceylan responded extremely quickly, and everything is as described in the apartment listing. When I visit Istanbul again, I'll definitely choose this accommodation again.

What a great Host! Very clean, exactly as shown and you will not meet a better person than Ceylan! She made us feel so welcome and truly there was nothing we needed extra. What a breath of fresh air for your weary travels! Highly recommend staying at her flat, coffee shops all around, take a walk and explore the area! You won’t be disappointed here!

The place is a very clean, chic, and welcoming place. It is one of the cleanest Airbnb places I have ever stayed. It is not a huge place but I stayed with my wife and daughter and felt very comfortable. It is not only a great place but also the host is awesome. Ceylan and her helper were one of the nicest people you would get to know while you are in Istanbul. They went beyond our expectations from giving us great tips to get around the city, to accommodating our needs whenever we asked for help or requested something on many occasions. That made a huge difference in our trip in a great way. I am very glad to stay there and you will be, too. I would recommend it to anyone who visits Istanbul and need a place to stay.

Ceylan is a great host
The experience was convenient and comfortable, the place is pretty clean
Would highly recommend her

description:
On each floor there is a spacious 1 + 0 apartment for 2 people with a bathroom. There is a shared kitchen on the first floor. The whole house has 4 floors.

You can easily access everything in this place, which is centrally located in Beyoglu, the heart of Istanbul. The apartment has been newly restored and is immaculate.

reviews.text:
Time for a perfectly honest review ...
Good points: Room was clean and bed was comfortable. Location was central to the area of Beyoğlu. Atacan (the acual physical host) was friendly and helpful.
Bad points: Room needs blackout blinds as there is a street light right outside the window and other windows from across street can see in. Room had no running water at times. I understand that Turkey suffers from water issues but this needs to be made apparent in the advert for people paying to stay there. Street is noisy at night well until midnight (mostly children screaming). Street does look very run down and smells like fish. You'll probably be venturing into the centre so you may be able to look past this. TV doesn't work. Check-in could be improved by telling us the actual number of the house. Based on this, I feel the price should be significantly lowered.

Yasmin's place is really worth to stay. New building, clean and complete facility for mid-term stay. The kitchen is fully functioning and the appliance is complete. The bedroom is also spacious. The location to the bus stop to attraction area is only 3 mins walk. Yasmin n her colleague is also very helpful. She helped us to book taxi to the airport. Me and my mother really enjoy our stay at Yasmin's place. Until next time!
Great location and great host. You need anything and the host will help you in that. The kitchen is spacious and clean and the room is also as described in the posting.

Me and my friend had a really great time on our vacation in Istanbul. The room we stayed in at Yasmin's apartments was clean, big enough and everything we needed during our stay. The thing that slightly bothered us was that you couldn't fully close the shower so everytime we showered the whole bathroom got wet. The great benefit of the room was the mini fridge:). The location of the apartment complex is in a really poor neighbourhood of Beyoglu which was kinda shocking to us since we are not used to this kind of living situation. At first we were a bit scared, but than we got used to it and there were mostly just children and women which didn't even mind us being there. The annoying part was just that children were loudly playing on the street under our apartment till very late in the night. We were gone going around the city from early in the morning till night time and the room was great for the time we needed it. And since the apartment is not in the "centre" or where all the big atractions are is 5min away from the main road with bus stations and taxis, but we prefered the metro (line M2) which is also pretty close, 15min walk and we were in the "centre" of the city in 10min. Overall we had a great time, but since we didn't get to meet Ms Yasmin, she was always available if we needed anything and her colegue Mr. Atacan, who greeted us was really nice as well.

Spent only 3/7 nights in this aparts and leave it by myself.
Aparts are located at very dangerous and poor region of Istanbul. Every our fellow travelers from our friends to taxi drivers tells the same. It's very dirty on the street, bad smell (people carve shellfish in cellars) , a lot of children are shouting loudly at night, it was such feelings that I'm not in Istanbul, but in Bangladesh.
I think it's not just uncomfortable but unsafety to live in such accommodations especially with wife/girlfriend or children. I have wrote a latter to Yasmin with the request to cancel my reservation but she defused it. My recommendation is to add information about environment around in your add.

description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay.

reviews.text:
In general, I liked the apartment and the stay.
advantages:
1. great location. metro entrance right next to the building. Walking distance to a large waterfront park. there are restaurants and cafes, everything is very convenient
2. good building. the building itself is new, combined with the hotel. you can use the pools (there are outdoor and indoor) and the gym for free (although you need to bring your own towel, but that's a trifle). for an additional fee you can have breakfast in the hotel restaurant (buffet), very convenient.
3. the apartment itself is well furnished, there is a comfortable new sofa, workplace, dining table, automatic blackout curtains. bed is good, mattress is comfortable. you can see the sea from the window.
disadvantages:
1. the apartment was rather dirty:
- firstly, on the bathroom floor at the very first moment I saw black hair on white tiles. the host answered my question, saying, yes, there is hair everywhere! To be honest, I didn't even have an answer. in my practice, usually the host in this situation tries to do at least something / clean up on his own / offer additional cleaning, - in general, tries to do at least something. but no. eventually cleaned up on our own. the carpeting throughout the apartment is also not super clean, professional cleaning will benefit the carpet.
- secondly, the shower room has black mold in the joints. there is not much of it, but it is there, so keep this in mind if you are asthmatic or allergic.
- thirdly, i was disappointed because of someone else's food and opened medicines left in the refrigerator.
in general, the impression of the apartment was rather positive, despite the serious lack of cleaning, which is especially striking in contrast with the shiny hotel building and common areas. I hope these problems will be fixed and then the apartment will be almost perfect.

We spent almost two weeks at Mitra's apartment. The apartment is located in a 5-star hotel complex. Great value for money. The view was beautiful and we enjoyed the view from the bed and drinking coffee next to the window. The entrance to the metro station is just outside. The apartment is new, very modern and has everything you need for a long stay. Mitra is a great host, speaks english and will gladly help with anything you need. We would definitely stay here again.

We stayed at Mitra’s apartment for a week and had a lovely experience. The apartment is located in the hotel building and we had access to all the amenities, including a wonderful outdoor pool and sun loungers.
It is located in the heart of Maltepe and only 1 minute walk to Maltepe Metro station. Mitra is an excellent host and communication was great. We truly enjoyed our stay and will definitely come back in the near future. Thank you !

Mitra is incredible. She was very accommodating and very quick to respond with any questions. She is also flexible with check-in and check-out time, which was extremely helpful. The place was very clean and had all of the necessities for a week to stay.
The apartment was walking distance to some tourist attractions, and it was close to metro.This is definitely the perfect place to stay in Istanbul.

Lovely apartment with great transport connections. Metro station entrance is literally on the doorstep. Really good communication from the host: always got back to me very promptly and always willing to help. The apartment was a little warm at times but the air con worked well and cooled the rooms down quickly. Lovely views of the city and the sea as the apartment is on the 16th floor which I wasnt expecting and was a nice surprise. Maybe more could be made of this in the description of the apartment.
Slightly confusing the check in as it wasnt so clear that the apartment was inside a luxury hotel. It was another nice surprise though as you got access to the hotel's facilities like swimming pools, gym, sauna and restaurant.
I would definitely recommend and use again if ever in that part of Istanbul in the future.

description:
Step into a thoughtfully designed home in the heart of Istanbul. This ground floor two bedroom apartment combines modern comfort with everyday practicality, offering a calm and convenient stay within one of the city’s most vibrant neighborhoods. The apartment features its own private garden, creating a peaceful outdoor space to relax and unwind.

Whether you are here to explore the city or work remotely, everything you need for a perfect stay is right at hand.

reviews.text:
My 6 family members and I stayed in a 2-bed, 2-bath unit with Noa Luxury Apts. for 10 days and truly enjoyed it. The apartment was modern, spacious, clean, and had all the amenities we needed. Most of the staff at the apartment complex don't speak much English, but they are very friendly and helpful (*hint* Google Translate works wonders). Noa also has a very modern gym with showers and a sauna that are all free to use for guests staying at the complex, and they even offer massages (not free).
The location is fantastic. 2 minute walk from the Galata tower and a 5 minute walk from the nearest tram station. There is also a multitude of restaurants and shops just a short walk away. Finally because the apartment building is in a narrow side street, it is very quiet despite its proximity to the hubbub of the Galata tower plaza.
While there are cheaper options available nearby, overall it's a great place to stay if you're willing to pay for the modern design and amenities. My family and I will definitely consider staying here again if we revisit Istanbul.
Not recommended dirty bathroom no AC in the bedrooms bad location bugs in the apartment horrible will never come back ever and hight price

The NOA apartment is just perfect - one of the best we ever had rented! The location is the best for Istanbul as per my experience after multiple visits. The apartment itself was super clean and had everything we needed - even the drinking water, tablets for the dishwasher, washing powder, all the kitchenware etc. There is a fish market nearby, so we were able to cook delicious and fresh fish and shrimps from there. Everything is well maintained and looks modern and very convenient. The only thing someone might not like - there is not enough lightning inside, but for us it was good enough. We were staying with our friends - 4 adults and 3 kids. Aylin was very responsive and helpful - thank you very much!

We stayed at Noa on the ground floor apartment,
- Location is really great , almost next to Galata Tower which makes is really good spots for tourists to the city as most of spots are at walking distance
- Apartment matched the pictures and description
- We had issue with exhaust in the washrooms which Noa deemed cant be fixed, due to which it was foggy in washrooms if u took a shower, so kind of a blip on overall good experience
- We requested for extra towels as we had 5 days of stay and the team helped with that
Generally host is responsive and would try to help out if they can, there is on site security in daytime who can assist if you require some help and in night u can enter the building using code at the door, on check out you can leave bags with security as well

We are family of 5, overall stay for 4 nights was amazing. Location is a walking distance to most attractions however if travelling with senior who require wheelchair like us might not be so accessible due to the road, hill up etc.
Check in was just smooth and very helpful staffs. Great heating throughout the house, thick towels, drinking water was provided for the stay. I would sure to return again here, thank you for everything.

description: Our house is a city full of stylish and comfortable apartment! Suitable for four people to stay and within walking distance to many historical attractions, is located in a central location. Enjoy easy access to all major subway lines and the terrace!

reviews.text:
Necati is a great host - he is very friendly, helpful, welcoming and flexible.
The location of the apartment is great. It is really close to the biggest landmarks such as Hagia Sofia or Blue Mosque in Sultan Ahmet district.
The apartment itself was neat and clean. It wasn't 100% as per the photos since in the photos I could see 3 beds - 1 queen bed and 2 single beds but in the apartment it was 1 queen bed, 1 single bed, and 1 single mattress on the floor. But the apartment has almost everything one mostly needs during their trip.
One thing to surely consider is the approach to the apartment. Our apartment was on 3rd floor (considering ground floor as floor zero) and since there is no elevator, it can become a bit difficult for elderly people or children to climb up or down all those big stairs.
Overall, considering the price of the apartment per night which was cheaper than the most in this great neighborhood, one can fairly say that this apartment offers good value for your money!

We stayed at the Sah Apartment Hotel for a week in mid-October. For the price, it was an enjoyable stay. The location of this AirBnB is tremendous; it is only a block and a half from the Hippodrome; restaurants are nearby and the Sultanahmet Tram station is only two blocks from the hotel. The street where the hotel is located is a back street which is quiet, except for the school across the road. It is not a fancy hotel, situated as it is above Necati's carpet store. We felt very safe there and Necati was there from 9 in the morning until 7 at night every day but Sunday. He let us leave our bags there when we arrived early and the cleaning person washed and dried laundry that we needed looked after as we had been travelling for awhile. The bed was comfortable, the water was always hot when we needed it to be, and some of the furnishings were actually quite nice, except for a very tired looking small rug on the floor. If you are planning to use the kitchen for any type of meal beyond breakfast, you will find only the absolute basics provided. There was no sharp knife that could cut anything and no kitchen towel. When we asked, we were told we should use paper towels that were provided. While we had a Vodafone card for our cellphone, there is basically no wi fi, although there is a wired connection which could be connected to a laptop if you bring one. Overall, the value and location outweighed the minor deficiencies we encountered. For the money, it is a good choice, and Necati is a pleasant and gracious host.

We stayed at Necati's place for two nights only, so our feedback can't be the most representative one.
The location is very central and pretty quite at the same time which made convenient commuting and relaxing. We wanted to be closer to the main sights and can now be too sure that we wouldn't have found a better location. 3 min walk to Hagia Sofia and Sultanahmet Mosque. 4 min walk to tram station which takes you to the airport. Huge convenience store available just 4 min walk and a number of bars nearby.
The host responded to messages in seconds and was very kind to help on directions. Necati was very hospitable, helpful and approachable.
The flat is very cosy and convenient for i would say 5 people, we were just 4 and there was plenty of space. All living amenities were provided, such as kitchen appliances and dishes, towels, beds and so on - all clean and fresh.
Overall - very satisfied with the stay. Would recommend to everyone else.

This apartment is great! The location and price cannot be beat. The only down side is that it was on the 4th floor with no elevator and a very narrow staircase. This was only a problem when we arrived and had to carry our luggage up to the 4th floor and when we left and had to carry the luggage down.
The apartment is nothing super fancy, however, it is very clean, with a fridge, oven, sink and basic kitchen needs.
The location is unbeatable. We exited the building and walked a few feet and saw the beautiful minarets of the blue mosque and the Haga Sophia. There is a certain beauty and serenity that I cannot describe in the apartment and the neighborhood in which it is located. I would highly recommend this apartment for anyone who is planning a visit to beautiful Istanbul!
Thank you Necati!

Few minutes walk from Sultanahmet and tram station - which was what I was looking for. Room was big and comfortable, fairly clean. Next time I’d prefer lower floors, instead of the highest. Wifi was 3/5. Host was responsive and kind.

description:
Stay in a garden-level home in one of Kadıköy’s most desirable neighborhoods, close to Bağdat Avenue, Marmaray and metro links.

Enjoy the rare comfort of a home with a garden while staying near cafés, shops and the seaside. I

Ideal for healthcare visits, with easy access to major hospitals such as Acıbadem, Yeditepe and Florence Nightingale. The garden level also makes everyday access easier and more comfortable.

reviews.text: Great host and flat. The pictures and description are accurate and we were incredibly pleased and happy with the location and flat. The cats are a lovely addition to the home of being around the patio. The only thing was we were without central heating for most of the stay, October evenings are quite chilly and this made us all quite cold with limited mini heaters around the home. We appreciated the extra blankets during this time! Might be worth investing in some extra portable heaters for the colder months when the central heating isn’t on! Besides this we had a pleasant stay. Would love to come back again during the summer season too!

I had a lovely experience at Serkans spot! The house was super cozy and felt just like home. It is decorated very stylishly and is comfortable! The house was exactly like the pictures and very clean. We had a smooth check in it was lovely. Even thought it is summer and hot, the apartment was not hot since the sun doesn’t shine through so the fan was enough. Location wise it was amazing as well and Serkan was a great host very responsive and hospitable! 10/10 recommend

Serkan was always responsive and helpful with everything. He accommodated all of our requests and even delivered a spare key to our door when we needed it. Place was clean, kitchen was well-equipped, and beds were comfy. The only thing thing was I was not aware of the age of the building when I was booking the place and was surprised when arrived at the location but could’ve asked before booking so that’s on me.

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment. The house was perfectly clean,even though it is on the entrance floor and is close to the garden.The bed and towels were more than enough and very clean.
There were no personal belongings of the owner in the house,which I always prefer in Airbnb stays.The apartment is beautifully designed and decorated in a way that makes you forget it’s located in an older building in the area.The location is amazing,everything is within walking distance,metro,metrobus,the main street and the seaside.The kitchen essentials were sufficient.I preferred to cook during my stay,and some pans were initially missing,the owner immediately sent them.There are cats around, and food was prepared for them.People who know Istanbul will understand and probably love this.But who is very sensitive to smells(even though I love cats),this was a bit challenging for me.I have stayed in many Airbnbs around the world. In terms of cleanliness, this was definitely one of the best!

The place was super cozy! Staying somewhere for a week I highly recommend, they have all kitchen supplies where you can cook a meal and feel at home! Serkan and his co hosts are beyond amazing, they were always super responsive to me whenever I had a question. Super friendly and amazing people! In the 5th day of the stay they had a cleaning lady come clean and replace bedsheets and towels never had an Airbnb host extend to that level without even asking they just did so. I highly recommend this beautiful home for your next stay in Turkey. The only thing I would say the beds aren’t super comfortable so only recommendation to the host would be to get a memory form cover to help with that but otherwise everything was amazing!
Thanks again for making me stay super pleasant! I truly appreciate it.

description: For information, insta kivancturhan1 The apartment with three twin bedrooms and a living room is in the middle of Şişli, Nişantaşı and Beşiktaş, Taksim Square is one metro stop away, Cevahir and Mecidiyeköy Square is a 20-minute walk to Beşiktaş. Metro, Bus and Metrobus stops are within walking distance to Taksim and Istanbul Airport and all over Istanbul. Although your home is centrally located, it is in an apartment building on a quiet and safe street where families live. It has an outdoor parking lot.

reviews.text: Truly spacious, relatively clean, calm neighborhood. The kitchen was ok but the refrigerator wasn't clean. The toilet/bath was also ok but slightly different from the picture(no bathtub). The bedrooms were clean, bedsheets looked clean but since had stains on them can't say for sure, there were dirty clothes in one of the closets. The balcony is big and nice. hall room was big and clean. The tv/wifi was great. ~15min walk to metro/bus station, many stores around to get what you need. Kıvanç was very responsive. all in all, good place, good price.

We got a 3 bedrooms apartment for the price of a studio in same area, great value for what we paid! The host is very responsive and helpful! The neighborhood was very nice but not bear metro or bus, we had to walk at least 15 min to get to it. Thank you!

Kıvanç was a great host and very fast responding. The house was very clean and had all the necessary items for cooking and a short stay. The location was also very convenient and ~15 minute walk from bus/subway station. We enjoyed our stay.

pleasant apartment, in a quiet and wooded location. the furniture is a little old but no problems. close to shops and the metro station. Helpful host, we forgot some luggage and he kept it until we could get it back.

Geldiğimde Kıvanç Bey sağolsun apartmanı bulmamda yardımcı oldu. Ev gayet temizdi düzenliydi. Rahat bir biçimde kaldım. Mesajlara da kısa sürede cevap veriyor. Evde kalmak isteyenlere tavsiye ederim :))

description: This stylish apartment is located in one of the most lively areas of the city, surrounded by bars, cafes, and restaurants. it is on the second floor, and there is no elevator.

reviews.text: Everything is just like in photos. It is a clean recently renovated apartment . It also has a AC which is super nice for hot İstanbul summer nights. The location of place is perfect and Akif was very responsive to any question that I had during my stay. Only downside of this place is that it is on a bar and kind of loud if you go to sleep early and I think this is the cost of staying in middle of Kadikoy. Overall I recommend Akif’s place to everybody.

Akif's place was cosy, clean and well equipped, perfect for those who want a base within a lively neighbourhood with everything nearby and in walking distance. Functional kitchen, very comfortable bed, spacious enough. Great value for money! Akif was a great host, very easy to communicate with and helpful and proactive throughout my stay. Would definitely come again!

The apartment was exactly as pictured- spacious, lots of light, and equipped with everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The other reviews are correct that it’s not a quiet neighborhood, but the noise never interfered with our sleep or work calls- and It was more the worth it to be in the middle of a lively and interesting area! Akif was a wonderful and responsive host, and his recommendations made the stay even more enjoyable. I would happily return in the future.

The apartment looks exactly as it was described. Great location, close to a metro station and ferries. There is a bar downstairs, so it might be noisy in the evening and at night. The smell of cigarette smoke wents up to the apartment through a ventilation hole in a wall and open windows. And there is a strong smell of cigarette smoke in a porch of the building. Be aware if you are sensitive to it.

Akif is a great host. Anytime we had an issue he was very helpful and assisted us as soon as he could. The place is exactly as it looks in the photos. The kitchen is well equipped as if people actually live there. The neighborhood is awesome, very lively with a ton of restaurant and bars. The street noise can be loud when you’re sleeping. I def recommend!

description:
15 minutes walk to Emaar Shopping Mall, 20 minutes walk to Göstepe Bridge and metro. Complete, stylish and spacious studio apartment on the second floor suitable for a maximum of 2+1 family accommodation (1-king 1-single bed)

(Optionally, I can provide transportation with my private vehicle)

reviews.text:
I would strongly recommend this placeas it was a great value for money, especially in Istanbul. It has all the comfort convenience you expect.
Wonderful clean and easy to find self checkin
A big space bedroom, modern fully equipped kitchen and balcony.
It's located in a very quiet, peaceful area. and you can access all Istanbul from here. As central areas are max 20 to 30 mins.
just teps away from the main road full of shop stores restaurants of all kind.
Host Mustafa is very, very nice, diwn the earth man. whenever I need something, he comes in 15 mins and asks me what help I need.
I would really ask all people coming to try staying in his place.

I was staying in the apartment for 1 month and it felt like home. Apartment is very spacious, clean and nicely furnished. It has a great wifi connection and a washing machine. Furthermore Mustafa is really a great and kind host. He provided me a transportation from the airport and he offered me a transportation to my workplace in Ataşehir. He is always very responsive and cares for your weel-being. Also the price is very good compared to other apartments in the neighborhood. I only have positive things to say about my stay in the apartment and would definitely come here again.

First of all Mustafa was a very friendly and attentive host. There was an issue with the internet the first few days but Mustafa went out of his way to solve the issue. The apartment was nice and clean. The kitchen had plates, silverware and some pots just in case anyone wanted to make a quick meal at home. The neighborhood is nice and calm and people were very friendly. The bus station is 2 minute walk from the apartment so no problem with transportation. I was is Mustafa's apartment for 2 months and he always checked up on me to check if everything was good or needed anything. Awesome experience!!

Mustafa is very friendly and responsive. The great advantage was he provided transportation whenever I needed. Very clean room and kitchen. Only the bathroom is little small but, very clean too. Peaceful surroundings and all types of restaurants and groceries are walking distance. Public transport available but, I didn’t use. It was a great stay for me..

This place is a quiet, clean, spacious and calming place. It is very near the and close to all the lovely restaurants and parks. kitchen is well equipped and clean.
. The whole place made us feel at ease. Mustafa was very helping, easy to talk to and very friendly when welcomed us. I would definitely come again!

description: Decorated with modern furniture this spacious apartment offer 32'' LED TV, fully equipped kitchen, air conditioning, a work desk and a chair, Laptop safe box and private bathroom with free toiletries and hairdryer. It also has city view.

reviews.text: Upon arrival there was no one at the front desk but shortly after a very friendly gentleman greeted me and immediately got me checked in and upstairs to my room. I can just say the decor throughout the entire hotel was so beautiful and modern. The elevator was small but other than that everything in the room was nice and state of the art. Every request I called for they filled my needs right away. I managed to get sick and they went out and purchased orange juice and water and brought it to my room. They were very helpful in directing us to whatever destinations we desire. Very lovely experience. Very friendly staff. The housekeeper was not very consistent with daily cleanups but would come if you request from the nice gentlemen downstairs. They definitely made my first visit to Turkey a lovely one. If i return to Istanbul I will definitely stay here!

The place is in a quit place, but in few minutes walk from the Istanbul's prestigious and lively Nishantashi area. 15 minutes walk to underground station. For me it had one more advantage - to be close to the places to be visited and friend's residence. Apartment slightly differs from what you see on photos, but it is better than expected for it's price. The items are used, but they are in pretty good condition. Compared to the hotels in this area offering the same or cheaper price than Carina Suits - my choice would be the last one again. There are plenty of fine dining places with very good prices, there is big shopping mall City's with cinema in few hundred meters. In general I would call it the best option in this area of the city.

Just to be clear, Carina Park Suites is technically an hotel. The room was nice and comfortable, and it is walking distance from many stores and restaurants. They also have basic breakfast at the hotel (additional cost). It is very convenient for the area. Our only issue is that people came in to clean the room (make the bed, etc) while we were out even though we had the "do not disturb" sign hanging in the door specifically so this wouldn't happen, but I guess a quick chat with the front desk should take care of that.

Onur and the staff were great. They were very helpful and were always available to reply or solve any issue.
Once we stayed for a few weeks, we would like to cook and they provided all the kitchen utensils.
The apartment is only 10min away from the metro station in a good neighborhood which has many supermarkets and restaurants.
The apartment is confortable for two people with a small bathroom well equipped.
The cost and benefit is very good. We are very happy with the service provided and definitely we intend to come back when in Turkey.

The place is clean and spacious but there were some problems that mean I wouldn’t stay there again. The biggest issue for me was that the walls are paper thin and there was a lot of noise from the people in the surrounding rooms. There is not a fully equipped kitchen - just a few plates and pieces of cutlery, so it’s not suitable if you want to cook your own meals.

description:
Welcome to a stay at an apartment in a newly renovated historical building , which faces the historical tourist attraction of ISTANBUL "Galata Tower" ( From were you can have a breath-taking 360 degree view of ISTANBUL ) This apartment is centrally located next to major tourist attractions, right in the center of Istanbul.

It has every basic amenity you will need and is designed to make you feel "Home away from home" from the moment you step in.

reviews.text:
My family enjoyed their stay at Guest Teori's listing in Galata! The pros were the location (literally right next to Galata tower and a fun neighborhood with restaurants, souvenirs, pharmacy, etc). Also in the same building on the 5th floor is a café with amazing view of the city and food was good. The listing was as described in the photos. Taxis can drive up to the building. Some feedback i saw mentioned noisyness at night but I found it really quiet (but I went in December which is the off-season).
The things I will mention to be mindful of is that it is right between a Cafe and a souvenirs store so it is easy to miss. Once you input the code you need to push the door (the door is missing a know but works). Once inside, there are a few steps before you reach the elevator which are unavoidable (important if you have a disability like myself but was able to manage with family).
The host was responsive when I had wifi issues and was proactive with check in and check out messages.

Great stay! The property was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully equipped with everything we needed. The airbnb was literally right next to the Galata Tower which was a highlight and made our mornings truly special.
The location was perfect as it was central to the Galata area which had a lot of establishments around. Host was very accommodating and had clear instructions, the photos were very helpful too!
Overall, we highly recommend this property!

I had a wonderful stay! The location was unbeatable just a few meters from the Galata Tower, making it easy to explore the area on foot.
The apartment itself was perfect very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described.
The host was incredibly communicative and supportive throughout my stay, always quick to respond and helpful with anything I needed.
I highly recommend this place and would definitely stay here again.

Very well priced, location was great, check in was super easy, great living room and kitchen, bathroom, and master bedroom. The second bedroom is very small with no closet or bedside table or much space to move around but it does have a queen bed. Worth the stay!

My stay was absolutely amazing! The place was exactly as described – clean, cozy, and well-equipped. The location was perfect, and the host was incredibly friendly and helpful. I felt completely at home and would love to come back. Highly recommended!

description: Nice well-decorated one bedroom 52m2 apartment, all-equipped,inside a secured residence. High speed internet, Live TV application includes worldwide satellite channels, movies, and series. Free parking. Grocery store within the residence. Heating and air-conditioning available. One A/C in the living room and One Fan in the bedroom.

reviews.text: The host Amal is very polite and she was very responsive, im quite happy with my stay in general. The house looked exactly like the photos and was provided with all the essentials as well. Recommended 🙏🏼
Giriş çok kolaydı ev fotoğraflarda gözüktüğü gibiydi ancak temizlik konusunda çok fazla eksileri vardı yatak çarşafları lekeliydi camlar leş gibiydi resmen kir kalıp oluşturmuştu.

That was the first time that I was in Istanbul.
And the flat was clean and tidy.
Check in and out were easy to do without any complex.
there have always been taxi in front of the tower or sometimes you wait less than a minute to catch a taxi.
There was a small supermarket in near the tower.
Totally, it was awesome.
Thanks Amal

If I had known this would happen, I would have chosen a different place. The aparmtment, Stowers area is filled with escorts, immigrants & many more. The site itself and the inside of the house was a mess. The landlord said it was clean and I quote "its already clean but clean it yourself jf not satisfied". When I've entered the house bathroom door was full of stains, there were hair on bed sheets and yellow stains on the pillows, the whole house was covered with dust and stains. If I had known this I wouldn't have come

very nice place, very clean
worth the value

description: Spacious and modern 2+1 apartment in the heart of Kadıköy. 50 meters away from the iconic bull statue, easy access to a myriad of cafes, bars, shops, and convenient public transportation options. Immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of this bustling neighborhood, where endless opportunities for exploration and entertainment await just steps from your doorstep.

reviews.text:
Spacy and Convenient Stay at the center of Kadiköy
A Home Away From Home.
My recent stay at Orhun's apartment was nothing short of fantastic. From the moment we booked Orhun was prompt and helpful. Check-in with clear instructions and easy access to the apartment.
The apartment itself was exactly as pictured. It was spacious and clean. Having a washing machine, a dryer and reliable Wi-Fi was a huge plus and made our stay so much more convenient.
The location of the apartment was also ideal. Everything was within a walking distance, near to public transport, close to shops and restaurants. It offered everything we needed for a comfortable and enjoyable stay. We would highly recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a convenient base for exploring the city, a home away from home.
We would definitely stay here again!
Would we recommend this apartment? Yes!

Good choice if you want to feel the rhythm of the city. The location is great cause all the public transport is in walkable distance - subway, buses, ferryboat. Even though there is a market right under the windows it was not noisy so we cant work during the day without distractions. When we checked in the apartment was not cleaned well but we contacted Orhun and he quickly resolved it and left us small sweet gift:) The apartment is spacious and has the second table which is very comfortable if you are going to work remotely from there. Internet is also good. But the AC is only in the living room and it might be a little hot in the bedroom cause it's far from AC. Also, what I liked the most in this apartment is that is has just everything you might need - from dishwasher capsules and washing powder to shampoo, soap and paper towels - so you don't need to worry about it which happens not very often with airbnb flats. Orhun is very polite and responsive host!

I stayed this place nearly for a month.
Orhun was a friendly host whose also quick to responce to any topic.
( For example i had a problem with the door nearly 03 am and he come to the place and fix the problem 20 minutes after my text.)
So thanks to Orhun for being a friendly and reactive host.
The location of the place is very central with 5 minutes walk to the every type of transportation and lots to do because of kadıköy's lively streets.
Entrance of the building is easy to access from the street and area of the building is safe and secure.
The house is very clean and all kind of the stuff that you need while staying in a home provided perfectly, thanks to our host.
In the period of my stay i don't get disturbed by the noise of the other residents or street vendors.
Air conditioning is good,
and host provided additional (portable) one for the rest of the house.
In the end, place was a good choice for my stay.
Wish all travelers safe journeys.

Nice and clean apartment, very central location. Active during the day, quite at night. Internet is reliable and pictures are accurate. Host is flexible and responsive, took care of minor issues immediately. Dryer is a nice bonus, rare to find in this part of town. Moda area in Kadıköy is the place to be if you want to be away from tourists and experience the social and cultural hub of locals.

Spacious, modern, and comfortable apartment with lots to do! Location is amazing - Right in the heart of Kadikoy, everything I wanted was within walking distance, and the ocean is only a 10-15 min walk. Available taxis and transportation, but I mostly walked everywhere.
The apartment was wonderfully stocked and very clean! I was very cozy here. Also stocked with bottles of water, toiletries, soaps, I never had to run out and get more things.
Very wonderful and comfortable home in the middle of a very lively city!

description:
In my house located right next to the first residential historical Istanbul region;
A fully equipped kitchen;
Public transportation everywhere;
Balcony with great view;
24-hour hot water, shower facilities;
Free Wifi;
Fan in the room,
Washing machine and free detergent;
Complimentary tea and coffee;
A great shared living room.
I'm waiting for you at my home. 🙂
My house is on a street walking uphill and is not modern as it is in most part of Istanbul.
Book now if you're sure my home is a good fit.🤗

reviews.text:
I had a great time during my stay. Özay is very helpful and always replies quickly, which matters a lot to me when traveling.
Pros:
- The house is situated on a small hill and requires around 10 mins walk uphill. For me that’s a plus since I appreciate a little bit of walk anyway. But it might not be so accessible for people with luggage.
- Easy to get around with public transportation. Although not in the city center, it was still easy for me to get to all the places I wanted to go with buses like 50N and 50E.
- The house is very clean and tidy. I think Özay spends most of the time in his room so that his guests would be more comfortable using the public area like the living room and balcony?
- I am a solo female traveler and felt safe in general in this neighborhood. It’s a residential area and there’s a school. I often saw kids walking or playing during my stay. For me that’s a good sign.
Cons:
- The house looks a bit more run down than the picture. Still very clean though.

The place is a great value for money, quite clean, not noisy, welcoming host, fast internet connection. Kitchen, fridge, and other things that are not present in your average hotel room, make this house just perfect for short-long term stay.
To reach the closest supermarket you will need to climb lots of stairs, but that’s not that bad, considering how healthy it is.

I have stayed the place for one month and a half.
Not very perfect, just an okay place to stay, pretty unsure how this place is a guest choice though.
Not for people afraid of bugs as some cockroaches were in the room, wardrobe and kitchen.
Neither for noise-sensitive person as some noise from nearby was loud. Also, back of refrigerator was in the room, so it made some noise, especially when someone opened it.
A table in the kitchen was not very clean and there was only a dirty towel to wipe it, which doesn't seem to be washed for long time, so I bought some paper towel myself.
Toilet seat was often wet with some liquid which was sometimes obviously someone's pee 😥
The hot water occasionally stopped while taking a shower.
Unfortunately, water outage occurred twice while I was staying.
The host was communicative, nice and tried his best.
The view from the balcony was nice.
Just one bus and 30 minutes to main places.
It might be a choice for people looking for a place to stay long.

Host communicated good enough, my apartment was fine for one night stand for spartan person. No noise cancellation. It was very easy to hear a neighbor in the next room. Very slow Internet (up to 1 mb/s). Very slick stairs to their apartment - I slipped, fell on the steps, and hurt myself badly. My leg hurt for a week.

Özay is a really good host to reply instantly. And he is really considerate for the information I needed. And the house was very clean with the beautiful view nearby and very quiet as well. It is recommended to anyone except who have a heavy luggage, as it will be hard to pull it up and down while walking to find the place. All in all, thanks Özay.

description:
The flat is located in one of the most popular areas of the city.
You’ll be directly enjoying the chic city center when you leave the apartment.
City's Mall is only 2 minutes away if you want to do some shopping or you can enjoy the fresh air by walking in Maçka Park.
The apartment is on the 4th floor and there is no elevator in the building.
The apartment is on a very secure street.
The street is quiet at night and very vibrant during the day.

reviews.text: The apartment was very clean and looked like the photos. But the apartment is on the last floor so over 70 steps up to the top. The kitchen lacked items for cooking properly but did have a microwave, but it wasn’t a big issue for me but could be for others. The tv is small and isn’t a smart tv so only Turkish channels are available. I had a nice stay apartment except the noise experienced from the people that live below and in the building next door. The owner is extremely friendly and helpful and these issues unfortunately can’t be controlled.

Baris and his Sister Cisel were very friendly and helpful. Cozy one bedroom flat in the middle of the city. You can walk anywhere in Nisantasi. But the building doesn’t have an elevator and the flat is on the 4th floor, keep that in mind if you mind taking the stairs. You have everything that you may need in the kitchen and the bathroom, i felt at home. Thank you 🥰🙏🫶

I had an amazing stay for four days. Barış and Çisel are incredibly friendly, kind, and attentive, always ready to share helpful information and ensure I had everything I needed. The room was super clean and quiet, providing a perfect retreat after exploring the area. The location was fantastic, with plenty of charming cafes, pubs, and restaurants within walking distance. I highly recommend staying here for anyone looking for a welcoming and comfortable experience.

Baris and Cisel I have no words how to thank u for my best experience on Airbnb. Your cozy lovely flat is too good to be true :) The flat is just perfect! Kitchen is compact and contains everything one needs. The bed is comfortable, bathroom excellent. Location is incredible. Cisel, u made me feel at home :) U went way beyond to make my long-weekend comfortable and memorable. I am waiting for u in Georgia.
Many thanks! I will be back :)

I used Airbnb during my travelling to many countries around the world but Baris and Cisel are by far the most amazing hosts I dealt with. They are very kind, responsive, and flexible when they can. The place is wonderful, clean and close to my attractions. The price is very good compared to the other places. I can’t say thank you enough to the amazing hosts. I will definitely choose to stay here again when I visit Istanbul next time.

description:
-This unit is located in one of the most central places in Istanbul. The building stands right besides the historical Camondo Stairs. You can walk to;
-Galata Tower,
-Karaköy,
-Galataport
-and Taksim in 5-10 mins.

You can also take the metro, tram, busses to anywhere.

-The 2 most important things we care is your security and hygiene. The building belongs to us. It has a security 24/7 and a free parking area. All rooms are cleaned by professionals cleaners.

reviews.text: Due to physical limitations we had repeatedly asked about the number of stairs to get to the apartment but were given incorrect info. We were told it was 9 steps total, however it was a total of 56 spiral steps, not including the 20 plus steps one must climb to get to the building. It was a daily challenge to go up and down all these steps with health limitations. The owner was nice and said the girl who gave us the wrong info left her job and they had recently taken over. Additionally we were told the apartment is guaranteed sound proof but it was not. Other than that the area is very hilly and on a steep incline so this information should be included when advertising. Bathroom shower had mould in the corners but the rest was clean. If we had the accurate info, we would not have chosen the place because of the sheer challenge of accessibility. It was too late for us to find a different place upon arrival so had no other choice.

The place was amazing. It’s secure, very clean and great location. It has got a lot of things to do around. Easy to reach a lot of touristic places just by walk. Even if you have a car, they do have they own carpark and they are very helpful so you won’t have an issue if you have a car as it’s quite hard to find a carpark in that area. And special thanks to Rumeysa as she was very friendly and helpful. Would definitely stay again and can recommend to everyone.

Beautiful place in a great spot. Everything was as described. Super comfortable. We had a minor issue where the electronic lock at the front didn't work for us on a couple of evenings, but the host responded immediately both nights and got it solved.

Great apartment close to galata tower and other attractions. Rooms are clean, fresh and modern. Has a nice balcony. Rumaysa was very helpful with anything that was needed. Only thing missing was the lift. overall great experience.
Konumu temizlik ve ev sahibinin ilgisi gercekten harikaydi kendisine çok teşekkür ediyoruz

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: We stayed 4 nights and payed a very reasonable price for this space. It's basic but has good light, a perfect balcony and both the bathroom and fridge were very convenient. The mattress looks old but the bedsheets are clean. As the ad mentions, there is no stove in the kitchen and no pots or pans but there is no need for this because you can find all sorts of restaurants really nearby. The gentleman in the shop downstairs is very kind and helpful. I do hope the airconditioning will be fixed someday because as you can read in other comments: it can only be turned on or off. So the best way to sleep during hot nights is with the airconditioning on and the window slightly open... which is not so environmentally friendly. It can also get noisy in the night with the window open. This detail will probably get fixed in the future. Just inform about it with the owner beforehand, if this is something important to you. Thank you Serhat, for a great stay!

Good location, nice place on the top floor with a balcony (has an elevator), clean and comfortable bed. We did book a little last minute so communication wasn’t amazing with the host but we managed to get the keys and get inside ok.
If you hear noises, it’s birds walking on the roof :). Overall worth the stay.

Ev temiz , güzel , fotoğraflarda olduğu gibi. Balkonu da çok güzel. Genel olarak memnun kaldık. Bir gün erken çıkmak zorunda kaldık işlerimiz olduğu için. Merkezi konumda etrafında her şey var. Açıkçası fiyata göre gayet güzel. Tek sıkıntısı otoparkı yok . Hemen yanında bir kaç tane ücretli otopark var ama biraz pahalı. Aracıyla gelip uzun süre kalacaklar onu hesaba katsın. Konaklamadan memnun kaldık kısacası teşekkür ederiz.

Daha önce yine Serhat beyde, aynı apartmanda başka dairede kalmıştık. Gerçekten fiyat performans olarak çok başarılı. Temiz, giriş çıkış konusunda esnek ve rahat, muhiti güzel bir yer. Söyleyebileceğim çok olumsuz taraf yok. Sadece karşı taraf oda içinde sigara içtiğinde kokusu sizin odaya da gelebiliyor. Aklıma tek olumsuz nokta bu geldi, onun dışında gayet iyiydi. Marketlere yakın, sahilin çok yakınında, girişi çıkışı gayet kolay, derli toplu bir bina. Teşekkür ediyoruz.

I will start with check-in, they told me to get the key from the market nearby by saying my name but when i went to market, they didnt know about it so we needed to wait for a while. And as i understood they were doing this job together with the guys in the market. When I kindly told them this is not a good way of check-in, their reply was pretty rude and low-level. In that moment i knew i made a mistake.
Secondly the place doesnt match with the photos. Im not saying the photos are fake but they are very misleading. I can clearly say the place looks much worse than the photos.
Thirdly, i forgot my macbook charger there(im 100% sure about it, i even knew where it was in the room) and i asked the host if i can take it back but he replied me as they didnt see any charger there. Then i said, i want to go and check it by myself but he didnt even reply me for days(still).
Im writing these because i feel like i need to warn other travelers. So please stay away from these people

description: New items, smart TV, Netflix, YouTube, everything is available. 106 screen LED TV, 30 m2 legendary place with living space.

reviews.text: Cemil bey ilgili alakalı mesajlara sorulara hızlı cevap verdi konakladığım yer anlatıldığı ve fotoğraflardaki gibiydi yatak banyo ve diğer yerler tertemizdi bi gece konaklamak için güzel bir yerdi

Konaklama yaptığımız oda fotoğraflarda gösterildiği gibiydi, odada klima mevcuttu, çalışan personeller oldukça güler yüzlü ve yardımseverdi. Otelin konumu ise metrobüs ve otobüs durağına oldukça yakın merkezi bir konumdaydı. Tekrar tercih etmekten şüphe duymayacağız.

Oda son derece temiz, ferah ve konforluydu. Dekorasyonu modern ve zevkliydi; her detay özenle düşünülmüştü. Yatak oldukça rahattı ve odanın sessizliği sayesinde çok kaliteli bir uyku deneyimi yaşadım. Banyo tertipli ve hijyenikti, hiçbir olumsuzlukla karşılaşmadım.
Ayrıca konaklama sürecimiz boyunca Cemil Bey’in profesyonelliği ve ilgisi gerçekten takdire şayandı. Kendisi son derece iyi bir konaklama sorumlusu ve ekibiyle birlikte misafir memnuniyetine büyük önem veriyor. Cemil Bey ve ekibi güler yüzlü, yardımsever ve her konuda destek olmaya hazırdı. Bu yaklaşım konaklamamızı çok daha keyifli hale getirdi. Genel olarak kendimi evimde gibi hissettiğim, tekrar tercih edilecek çok başarılı bir konaklama deneyimi oldu.

Kaldığım yerin ev olduğunu düşünerek gittik ve aksine bir otel işletmesiydi çarşaf ve yastık kılıfları kirliydi ve gerekli malzemeler sağlanmamıştı fiyat konusunda hiç bir sorun yok ama bilgilerini düzeltilmesi lazım
Cemil beyim yeri çok güzel ve temizdi herkese tavsiye ederim gönül rahatlığı ile gidip konaklayan bilirsiniz hersey için tesekküller cemil bey

description:

reviews.text: This place was disgusting! We checked in at 11pm and had to wait for the room to be cleaned. Check in is anytime after 4pm. This room should have been cleaned long before we arrived. Upon entering the room we encountered this overwhelming smell that made it really hard to breathe in there. We immediately opened the balcony door to get som fresh air in there, needless to say it did not help. The smell was still very pungent. I went to the bathroom and the smell was worse in there and I also discovered mold on the ceiling. We immediately checked out of this place and stayed somewhere else. I would never recommend this place for anyone to stay in.
Temizdi. Sicakti. Rahat ve konforluydu. Sadece cikis saatinin 11 olarak duzeltilmesi gerekiyor. Butun bunlar disinda konaklamadan memnun kaldim.
Girişte sorun yaşamadım,ilgiliydiler. Görseldeki gibiydi oda. Temiz ve rahattı.
Güzel temiz rahat
Gerçekten gösterilen odalar ile birebir aynıydı. Temizliği güzeldi ve geç saatte bile olsa sorularımıza cevap verdiler, teşekkürler

description:
Building completed in March 2023, The apartment built according to latest earthquake regulations and provides necessary safety and security measures. It also features free private parking lot and an elevator.


S House Chic features a clear view of 2 directions with a scenery of a peninsula is designed with the attention to every detail and your comfort in mind to give you the best possible experience in your accommodation.

reviews.text:
We booked an 8-night stay for the sea views and quiet atmosphere. Simay was a responsive host and the listing was accurate. The sea views were beautiful, and the location near Galataport was convenient. However, guests should be ready for many stairs in the area.
However, the bathroom had a hair-clogged drain which seemed overlooked by cleaning. Everyday we cleaned the place and Simay also reached out to me and appreciated our stay for being so clean and tidy. Our stay was peaceful during a local holiday, but once school resumed, the noise from about 100 students nearby was overwhelming, especially for my parents. For the price paid, this was disappointing. More upfront information about potential noise would have been appreciated to consider other options.

This is an excellent 5-star apartment! The host was very helpful, responsive and made our check-in process very clear. The apartment was clean & tidy, and had supplies for washing dishes, washing clothes and shampoo & shower gel. The washing machine & dryer worked perfectly and were very handy during our stay. The apartment has two bedrooms with air conditioning units as well as an ac unit in the living room. They all work extremely well and kept us cool during our stay (June 2025). The view from the living room is spectacular! Most days we ate our breakfast the kitchen counter and just gazed out at the Bosphorus; the view makes this apartment a one-of-a-kind property! You can walk up some stairs (lots of cats) and be in a buzzing district with cafes & restaurants & a big Carrefour grocery store. Most days we walked down the hill to use the tram to get around and then at the end of the day we took the funicular up to Taksim and had a pleasant stroll to the apartment.

The stay was wonderful! As soon as I arrived, I found water bottles in the fridge — such a nice welcome. The apartment was very clean, chic, and had everything I needed in the kitchen. The bed was comfortable, and I was absolutely hypnotized by the view. The area is super central, with lots of nice restaurants and bars nearby, and you’re just a short walk from Galataport. The only downsides were the Wi-Fi, which I couldn’t get to work even though they tried to help, and the price — I later found similar apartments for a bit less.

A very wonderful host, she responded to my inquiries in a very short time, she is really professional and made us feel at home
The view is much more beautiful than the pictures. It is a charming view and close to the Bosphorus port..and walking to Istiklal Street. Simay was quick to respond every time I contacted her and she was clear in everything. The apartment is comfortable, clean and wonderful on the third floor, with a full view of the Bosphorus and the port of huge ships. She was friendly even with my children and offered them sweets as a hospitality when we arrived. The most beautiful thing is that there is an elevator and the level of security in the housing is very high. No one can enter the building except with a private key.
I will come again soon

Koi house chic the most beautiful and stylish house I stayed in Istanbul. Words are not enough to describe the scenery. Definitely better than the photos. It is very difficult to find a new building with an elevator in this area, so I suggest you make a reservation without hesitation. Simay has thought of every little detail for comfort. everything was extremely clean and fresh. the beds were very comfortable. There is everything you need in the kitchen and bathroom. I feel very lucky to be their first guest. I will definitely come again.

description: The comfort of a centrally located home...

reviews.text: The hotel is conveniently located near the bus station that connects to the M4 metro. We stayed here for one night before catching our flight from SAW airport. The place is cozy and comfortable, and while the building doesn’t have an elevator, the staff were very friendly and helpful. Pendik is a nice area to experience local life away from the tourist crowds. Overall, it’s a great budget-friendly choice near SAW airport.
Konumu kolaydı, otopark sorunu yoktu. Oda biraz daha temiz ve bakımlı olabilirdi.
Konaklamamız genel olarak oldukça keyifliydi. Ev temiz, düzenli ve fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. Konumu çok iyiydi ve ulaşım açısından hiçbir sorun yaşamadık
Yatak çok rahatsızdı ve önce fotoğrafta gördüğümüz oda verilmedi
Oda gayet temizdi özellikle fiyatına göre beklediğimden fazlasını gördüğümü söyleyebilirim tek sıkıntı odaların yalıtımı zayıftı

reviews.text: The place was clean, bed comfortable and small kitchenette had everything we needed. The location worked out well for us: only a short walk from the tram that is just a few stops away from Sultanahmet! Suat was there to greet us on arrival and help with our biggest and heaviest suitcase up the stairs, and also brought us complimentary water! Host was quick to communicate, sent us a picture of the building from outside to help us find it easier, and also offered flexibility on slightly later check out. The area has many cozy cafes and neat vendors. We would stay again and definitely recommend!

We are so glad we chose this accommodation!
We stayed for 4 nights, and the apartment had everything we needed: clean towels and bed linens, a TV, a comfortable large bed, and a fully equipped kitchenette with a kettle, stove, and refrigerator. The bathroom was clean, and there were no issues with hot water.
The host was quick and friendly in responding to our questions, and the check-in process went smoothly.
The location is perfect – surrounded by plenty of cafes, bars, charming streets, and interesting shops. Despite being in such a lively area, the apartment was very quiet, with windows facing a small, beautiful courtyard with trees and cats.
A special thanks for the unlimited free bottled water!
For its price, the apartment is simply perfect, and we would definitely come back! Thank you!

Great location, comfortable bed, working AC and a nice bathroom. Stairs are steep and windy to the room which is good to know if you have large luggage. Room wasn’t ready at check in but the host let me stay a bit longer at checkout which I appreciated. Would stay here again.

Comfortable, cozy, and clean room in a great location 😄 Mehmet was easy to communicate with, and quick with his responses. Suat (who was at the reception) was friendly and very helpful, and kindly helped me with my luggage and other requests. Closing the windows blocked out any noise coming through, and the room was quiet. If you find the windows a bit heavy, would recommend asking someone at reception to help you.
The location felt safe - it's on cukurcuma caddesi, which has cute antique stores and cafes. Lots of restaurants / shops within walking distance.

We loved our time at this cute listing in Beyoğlu. The location is superb, just next door to the Museum of Innocence. The host is responsive and helpful. He waited for us to check-in and let us leave our luggage there after check-out. The room is clean and comfortable. Thank you for having us.

description: The apartment is a duplex consisting of the 3rd and 4th floors. The 3rd floor has a large living room, kitchen and bathroom. The upper floor has a bedroom and terrace. From this centrally located place, you can easily access everything as a whole group. It is within walking distance to places such as Galata Tower, Saint Anthony's Church, Aya Triada, Surp Ohan Voskiperan Church, which are 5 minutes from Istiklal Avenue. Eminönü, Sultanahmet, Karaköy, Üsküdar are all accessible using the bus and metro lines.

reviews.text:
This is a great place. We spent about a week here and had a lovely time.
Even though it's in a busy neighborhood, there's barely any noise from the street and we slept very peacefully. You're on the 3rd floor, so it feels very private and secluded. On the other hand it's within walking distance to the main Istiklal street, with all the cafes and restaurant.
The host Karabey made us feel right at home, he responded almost immediately to any request we had. Wifi was stable and fast (enough for zoom), the kitchen had enough equipment for simple meals.
The only thing to note is that the steps going to the upstairs bedroom are steep tricky, if you have some physical limitation this might not be for you.
Otherwise, we hope to come here again on our next Istanbul visit :)

This apartment was like a home away from home! I loved it so much I extended my stay for two weeks. It was it exactly like the photos and the host is so nice. The only downside is that you have to walk up three flights of stairs which isn’t fun with heavy luggage but without luggage it was fine. 5 mins from Istiklal street, supermarket 100 meters away, laundry just on the other side of the bridge. I’d definitely stay here again

I had a great stay at Karabey’s apartment in Istanbul. The location is excellent—right in the center of the city, making it very convenient to explore nearby attractions, restaurants, and public transport.
The apartment itself was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, with everything needed for a pleasant stay. Karabey was a helpful and responsive host, ensuring that the check-in process was smooth and that we had everything we needed throughout our visit.
Overall, it’s a fantastic choice for anyone looking to stay in a central, well-connected area of Istanbul. I would definitely recommend it and would be happy to stay again.

Absolutely amazing! The apartment is clean, cozy and spacious. Great location. Most importantly, Karabey is an amazing host- honest and kind, constantly trying his best to help and make our experience as comfortable as possible. You can book this place for sure!

I have good time while here. the location is strategic, the kitchen is good, heating and AC work well. The location walkable to Taksim, near small supermarket and local
restaurant, near bus station. located at 3rd floor but still OK. The host is very responsive, kind, and proactive. overall it is nice experience
