reviews.text: I enjoyed the convenient location and the welcoming staff. Everything I wanted to see during my short visit to Istanbul was within walking distance. There is a lovely terrace and rooftop with a nice view of the sea. The beds were comfortable, though a bit hard to climb up to the top bunk as a short person (there was nothing where the bottom rung of the ladder should have been). Showers were cleaned everyday. Some shelving in the shared showers to put toiletries on would be a great addition, as well as more sitting areas in the shared dorm rooms to avoid sitting on other people's beds. Overall, I enjoyed staying at Antique Hostel and would recommend it.

The host was friendly and relaxed. This hostel is in a fantastic location. We even had 2 car spaces out the front of the hostel.
We stayed one night in a 4 bed dorm and one night in a six bed dorm. The rooms were clean and the air conditioning worked well in the heat.

This place is very nice! Located in the shadow of the Blue Mosque, it is very close to many sites you might want to see. From the airport, it takes about 45-60 minutes to get to the hostel via metro and tram. There are plenty of restaurants and shops just up the street. Check-in was very easy for me. The shower was hot, hair dryers were available in the bathrooms, there was wifi, the bed was solid and comfortable, the sheets felt comfy, and the rooftop seating is a plus. I didn't have any problems with this place at all. I would definitely stay here again.

My stay at Antique Hostal was great! The location could not be better, the walk to Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque and the tram is only a few minutes. The room was clean as well as the common areas. The staff was friendly and helpful. I stayed in a room in the lower level. It was confortable but there was a little noise coming from the street and the room was illuminated by the street lights but nothing that disrupted my sleep. The place is safe and they were very flexible with check in and check out. I recommend this place and would definitely stay again.

One of the best locations for staying in old town Istanbul. You can reach the hostle by getting of the bus at Sultan Ahmet. Just 2 minutes walk from Hagia Sophia and 5 minute walk from other antient sites. Served with nice breakfast. you can enjoy sea view by sitting on it's nice terrence. Public bathrooms are clean. You can also meet different friends by staying it's 6 beds-dormitary room.

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
A wonderful place to stay near Taksim Square and Istiklal Street, reasonably priced. I had great communication with the host. I'll definitely recommend it to my friends. 👍🏠
The bedsheets and pillowcases are clean, but old and should be replaced. The TV is rather old and is mainly decorative. 📺🛏️

Quiet, peaceful place. Close to everything. Clean apartment, comfortable bed, sunny terrace. The photos match the ad. Great budget option. Arya is a very friendly host and a good person. Thanks for everything. I recommend.

fantastic location..lacking the basics. Only 2 towels provided, I recommend a hand towe for bathroom and a tea towel for the kitchen, we bought our own. Funky smell as you walk into he apartment which you need to get used to. Only 2 flat pillows provided and more delivered as per request. No iron. Perhaps think about having this down in the laundry room if you don't want them in the rooms. Could not get the TV or air con to work for the life of me. Couldn't even find the air con remote. Luckily the weather was perfect for day and evening. I think some sachets for coffee and tea available would give people a good start and welcome. Also a toaster would be a welcome addiction to the kitchen. All in all a good stay in a good location but get used to the drain smell and be ready to go and buy necessities.

Stayed for 5 days in Istanbul in March and had a good nights rest. The location is great near a bunch of cafes and restaurants. The place is generally pretty quiet and the wifi is good. Once I got the air conditioning going it was pleasant as the back bedroom and bathroom have no windows and can get kind of stuffy. I would come back and stay again and would recommend the place. The host was responsive.
just what we needed, simple but good and clean, great value for money. best part is the location, it's walking distance to everywhere you need

description:
1+1 Apartment in the Centre of Cihangir🏡
Near İstiklal Street (Taksim), Galata Tower & Galataport.

Perfect for couples & solo travelers.

Our cozy apartment is in an authentic area where actors, artists, writers, and performers live. The Cihangir area is where the filming of various Turkish TV series often takes place; there are many cozy cafes where you can have a delicious dinner or enjoy a delicious breakfast.

reviews.text:
I had a wonderful stay at this apartment. Everything was perfect, the place was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was also great and convenient.
The host was extremely kind, responsive, and very helpful throughout my stay, which made the whole experience even better.
I highly recommend this place and would definitely stay here again.

everything was perfect and we really felt comfortable staying at Istanbul, in this house. will recommend for my friends, other families and will definitely book again if I go back to Istanbul.

description: Modern apartment in a brand-new (2025) building on a quiet, charming street in Moda, Kadıköy—one of Istanbul’s most sought-after areas. Features 3 bedrooms with double beds, 1 living room, a fully equipped kitchen, and 2 bathrooms. Includes high-speed fiber internet, Smart TV, dishwasher, washing machine, AC, elevator, and all essentials. Just a 10-minute walk to metro, ferry, and public transport.

reviews.text:
We had a great time at this Airbnb! The apartment easily accommodated our family of 5, with two separate beds in one room and a private shower in another. It's all on one floor, and there's a nice elevator. The pictures are accurate, and the location is perfect – cafes are a minute away, and the sea is a quick 2-minute walk.
The apartment is quiet, and we loved the keyless entry. Berk, the host, was super helpful and even arranged a budget-friendly transfer for us.
Just a couple of suggestions for improvement: It would be nice to have AC in the smaller room, and maybe some basic kitchen supplies like cooking oil. We had no problem buying them ourselves, but Berk probably would have provided them if we asked.
Overall, we highly recommend this place for a comfortable and convenient stay in Moda!

Wonderful stay in Kadiköy, Moda!
We had a fantastic week at Berk's place with our group of friends. The apartment was tastefully furnished and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The 3-bedroom layout worked perfectly for our group of 4.
The location was excellent – a vibrant neighborhood with great cafes, restaurants, and easy access to transportation.
The apartment was clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described in the listing. We really enjoyed our time exploring Istanbul from this convenient base. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul, especially groups of friends looking for a comfortable and authentic neighborhood experience.
Thanks for hosting us, Berk!

We (4 adults and a 2-year-old child) stayed at Berk’s apartment for 8 nights. I hope this review will help others considering this place.
Pros:
The apartment has a spacious living room, which worked well for us.
The location is excellent. It’s close to the sea (just about 30–40 steps down), making it easy to enjoy seaside walks and beautiful sunsets.
There are plenty of cafés, restaurants, and a few grocery stores nearby.
The ferry is easy to access, making it simple to get to Istanbul’s main sightseeing areas.
Cons:
Two of the bedrooms have air conditioning (although we didn’t need it because the weather was cool, and opening the balcony door gave us plenty of fresh air). The third bedroom only has a fan, and its window faces a small air shaft, so there’s a musty smell if the window is open.
The host provided only one hand towel and one bath towel per person, and we had to buy our own cleaning supplies. The kitchen lacks basic essentials such as salt, pepper, oil, and garbage bags

Berk has been our host for two summers now, and we couldn’t ask for better. He’s incredibly responsive, thoughtful, and genuinely committed to making everything easy—from local tips to arranging smooth airport pickups. The apartment is spotless, spacious, and in the best part of Moda, on the Asian side by the water. You don’t see the sea from the windows, but it’s right there as soon as you step out. The building is immaculate, with a great elevator and quiet, powerful A/C. Despite the central location, the apartment is extremely quiet—no noise from the street or neighbors, thanks to solid modern construction. You’re just 30 seconds from Moda’s most vibrant street, full of affordable restaurants, cafes, and shops. The ferry to the European side is a simple 12-minute walk downhill—and in summer, the shaded route makes the uphill return easy. The neighborhood is safe, lively, and full of heart. This place really is a gem.

Great stay in lovely Moda, Kadikoy, Istanbul!
The house was open, airy and clean. It had everything we needed and was very comfortable for 6 people. The neighborhood was safe and quiet all day long. Bonus- the big windows with a peaceful breeze and sea view.
Walkable to all the restaurants and shopping you need, and an easy 10-15 min walk to reach the ferry to get to European side.
Hosts were very responsive and helpful. Would highly recommend this unit, or Berk’s other properties. There was a standard that we have not experienced in other Airbnb’s in Istanbul. We will definitely be guests of Berk’s in the future.
Thank you for the great stay! 😊🙏🏼

The host was very nice, responsive and accomodating. My only real problem was the neighbouhood, which is quite ghetto and didn't make me feel very safe.

The appartement was absolutely worth the money. It's located in a very interesting area where you can get a feeling for what it's like living in Istanbul. Still all the attractions are easy to reach with public transports. The appartement was beautiful and relatively clean. Would go there again any time!

description:
Welcome! This historic house in Balat is waiting for you to offer an unforgettable accommodation experience just a few steps from the sea. Here are some key features that make this house special:

Historical Value: This house is the perfect choice for those who respect Balat's rich history and cultural heritage.

Sea View: You can enjoy the magnificent sea view when you wake up in the morning or at sunset.

Central Location: You can easily access all of Balat's attractions.

reviews.text:
We stayed with our big family in the house. The location is great - very close to all the top attractions in Istanbul, the tram and bus stops just across the road, shops and good places to eat are also in walkable distance. Burak is very responsive and helped to sort some issues very quickly. The drawbacks are
1. Carwash is next to the house and it might be quite noisy, but if you are out most of the day, that's not an issue.
2. Kitchen is of a small size, so had to eat breakfast in turns. It may be my own fault that I did not see it in the property listing.
3. Hot water takes time to go up to the bathroom upstairs.
But overall we had a great time in Istanbul, and are happy with the property, it is a good place to stay for a reasonable price. Thanks for your hospitality.

Nice old apartment, very strategically located right on the Golden Horn. There is a tram stop nearby and in 10 min you can get to Galata Bridge and walk around exploring Sultanahmet district with its main tourist attractions or take a ferry from Eminönü to any other place in Istanbul or to go to Prince Islands, or take a Bosphorus tour. The apartment has 3 floors, so it is not an option for elderly people or small kids, as you need to take the steep stairs to get from any place to another. There are a few small shops and cafeterias nearby where you can buy basic stuff or take away food. Cooking at home, especially for a big company, will be difficult as the utensils set is minimal. The street is very noisy, even during the night time. The host is very responsive, reacting immediately to any questions. The communication, check-in and check-out were super easy.

Comfortable home in a beautiful location.
We toured the whole of Istanbul - taking public transportation from the airbnb as it’s right in front of the trams. Clean home with all listen amenities.

Apartament was great and very convenient, everything was clean and tidy. It was close to shops and public transport and located in a very nice neighbourhood. Burak was a great and helpful host and his place is a perfect place for a wonderful stay in Istanbul!
the house location was perfect near to the tram and bus station.burak was very responsive.all the amenities were there .
